quite a few students: Quite a few students in my class forgot to bring their homework today, so the teacher was not very happy.
我們班上不少學生今天忘了帶作業，所以老師不太高興。
a few more minutes: Can you give me a few more minutes to finish this math problem before you collect the papers, please?
在你收考卷之前，可以再給我幾分鐘把這道數學題做完嗎？
only a few: Only a few people came to the school party last night because it was raining really hard outside.
昨晚因為外面雨下得很大，只有少數幾個人來參加學校的派對。
few friends: Peter moved to a new town last month, so he has few friends there and often feels quite bored.
彼得上個月搬到新的城鎮，所以他在那裡很少朋友，常常覺得很無聊。
a few of them: There are twenty cookies on the table, and a few of them are for Grandma, so please do not eat all.
桌上有二十塊餅乾，他們當中幾個是給奶奶的，所以請不要全部吃掉。
a few（可數，有一些）: I have a few good friends at school, and we always eat lunch together at the same table at noon.
我在學校有一些好朋友，我們中午總是一起在同一張桌子吃午餐。
few（可數，幾乎沒有）: Sadly, few students passed the hard English test, so the teacher decided to explain the lesson one more time.
可惜幾乎沒有學生通過那次困難的英文考試，所以老師決定再講解一次課程。
a little（不可數，有一些）: Mom put a little sugar in my milk this morning because I do not like it too sweet.
媽媽今天早上在我的牛奶裡加了一點糖，因為我不喜歡太甜。
little（不可數，幾乎沒有）: We had little time to catch the train, so Dad drove really fast and did not stop for breakfast.
我們幾乎沒有時間趕火車，所以爸爸開得很快，也沒有停下來吃早餐。
a little tired: After playing basketball for two hours in the hot sun, Jack felt a little tired and wanted some water.
在大太陽下打了兩小時籃球後，傑克覺得有點累，想喝點水。
a little bit: The soup is a little bit too hot right now, so wait for a moment before you start eating it.
這湯現在有一點點太燙，所以等一下再開始喝。
a little more: This cake is so delicious that I would like a little more, but I am afraid of getting fat.
這蛋糕太好吃了，我想再多吃一點，但是我怕變胖。
a little late: Sorry, I am a little late this morning because the bus was full and I had to wait for the next one.
抱歉，我今天早上稍微晚了，因為公車坐滿了，我得等下一班。
know a little English: My grandmother knows a little English, so she can say hello and thank you to the foreign visitors.
我奶奶會一點英文，所以她能跟外國遊客說你好和謝謝。
a little at a time: The doctor told Amy to drink the medicine a little at a time, because it was too strong to finish quickly.
醫生告訴艾美要一次一點點地喝這藥，因為它太強，不能一下子喝完。
a lot better: After a week of rest and hot soup, Grandpa feels a lot better and can take a walk in the park.
休息一週又喝了熱湯之後，爺爺覺得好很多，可以去公園散步了。
Thanks a lot for helping me carry these heavy books to the library; I could not do it alone.
多謝你幫我把這些重書搬到圖書館，我一個人做不到。
a lot of fun: We had a lot of fun at the beach last Sunday, and we swam, played ball, and ate ice cream together.
上星期日我們在海邊很好玩，我們一起游泳、玩球和吃冰淇淋。
talk a lot: My little sister talks a lot at dinner, so sometimes nobody else in the family can say a word.
我妹妹吃晚餐時很愛講話，所以有時候家裡其他人一句話都說不上。
lots of: There are lots of fresh vegetables and fruit at the market in the morning, so Mom likes to shop early.
早上市場裡有很多新鮮的蔬菜和水果，所以媽媽喜歡早一點去買東西。
a lot more work: Students in high school have a lot more work than before, so they need to plan their time very well.
高中生比以前多很多的工作，所以他們需要好好規劃時間。
go abroad: My uncle wants to go abroad next year to see Paris, so he is saving money and learning some French.
我叔叔明年想出國去看巴黎，所以他正在存錢，也在學一點法文。
study abroad: Lisa hopes to study abroad in America after she finishes high school, so she practices English every day.
麗莎希望高中畢業後去美國留學，所以她每天練習英文。
travel abroad: My family will travel abroad for the first time this summer, and we are all excited about the trip to Japan.
我家今年夏天要第一次出國旅行，我們都對這趟日本之旅感到興奮。
live abroad: My aunt has lived abroad for ten years, but she still comes home to Taiwan every Chinese New Year.
我阿姨住在國外已經十年了，但她每年農曆新年還是會回來台灣。
from abroad: These sweet apples come from abroad, so they cost more than the ones from the farms in Taiwan.
這些甜蘋果是從國外來的，所以比台灣農場的貴。
go abroad（不加 to）: Many people like to go abroad during the summer vacation, and the airport is always very crowded then.
很多人喜歡在暑假出國，那時機場總是非常擁擠。
go to a foreign country: If you go to a foreign country, or go abroad for study, learn a few simple words of its language first.
如果你去外國，或是出國讀書，先學幾個那個語言的簡單字詞。
go overseas: My cousin will go overseas to work in Australia next month, and it is his first time to go abroad.
我表哥下個月要去海外在澳洲工作，這是他第一次出國。
Actually, I don't know where the new shopping center is, but we can look at the map on your phone.
其實我不知道新的購物中心在哪裡，但我們可以看看你手機上的地圖。
It actually works!: I pushed the old button on the radio that did not work just for fun, and it actually works again now!
我只是好玩按了那台壞收音機上的舊按鈕，結果它居然又有用了！
What actually happened?: Nobody in class is talking about the fight, so can you tell me what actually happened during lunch break today?
班上沒有人在談那場打架，所以你能告訴我今天午休到底發生什麼事嗎？
When my teacher asked whether I had finished all the homework, I smiled and said, actually, yes, I did.
當老師問我是不是做完全部作業時，我笑著說，其實，是的，我做完了。
again and again: The baby dropped the spoon again and again, and her mother picked it up every time with a smile.
寶寶一再地把湯匙丟到地上，她的媽媽每次都微笑地撿起來。
once again: Once again our team lost the basketball game by only two points, but the coach said we played well.
我們球隊再一次以兩分之差輸了籃球比賽，但教練說我們打得很好。
now and again: Now and again my grandfather tells us funny stories about his childhood in a small village near the sea.
我爺爺偶爾會跟我們說他小時候在海邊小村莊的有趣故事。
never again: After eating ten hot dogs at the night market, Tom felt so sick that he said never again.
在夜市吃了十根熱狗之後，湯姆覺得很不舒服，說再也不要了。
The new word is hard for me to hear clearly, so could you say it again, please, a little slower?
這個新單字我聽不清楚，請你再說一次，稍微慢一點好嗎？
all over again: The computer stopped working before I saved my report, so I have to type it all over again tonight.
電腦在我存檔報告之前就停止運作了，所以今晚我得從頭再打一次。
a long time ago: A long time ago, people in this town did not have cars, and they walked or rode horses everywhere.
很久以前，這個城鎮的人沒有車子，他們到哪裡都走路或騎馬。
ten years ago: Ten years ago my parents opened this small noodle shop, and now many people in the city know it.
十年前我父母開了這家小麵店，現在城裡很多人都知道它。
not long ago: Not long ago there was a big park here, but now a tall building stands in the same place.
不久前這裡有一座大公園，但現在同樣的地方站著一棟高樓。
a while ago: Your sister called a while ago and asked you to bring an umbrella because it may rain this afternoon.
你姊姊一會兒之前打電話來，叫你帶把傘，因為今天下午可能會下雨。
a moment ago: The teacher was standing right here a moment ago, so she must be in the office next door now.
老師剛才還站在這裡，所以她現在一定是在隔壁的辦公室。
ago + 過去簡單式: We watched a great movie two days ago, and I still remember every funny part of the story.
我們兩天前看了一部很棒的電影，我還記得故事裡每個有趣的部分。
before（之前；完成式）: Two years ago my family went to Japan, but I had never seen snow before that trip, so I was very excited.
兩年前我家去了日本，但在那趟旅行之前我從沒看過雪，所以我非常興奮。
three days ago: Three days ago my brother bought a new bike, but he already fell off it twice on the wet road.
三天前我哥哥買了一輛新腳踏車，但他已經在濡濕的路上摔下來兩次了。
three days before: Two weeks ago my cousin got married, and three days before the wedding she still could not find a dress.
兩週前我表姊結婚了，婚禮三天前她還找不到禮服。
go ahead: If you want to use my computer to finish your report, go ahead, because I do not need it tonight.
如果你想用我的電腦完成報告，請便，因為我今晚不需要用它。
ahead of time: We arrived at the train station ahead of time, so we had twenty minutes to buy some drinks and snacks.
我們提前到了火車站，所以有二十分鐘可以買些飲料和點心。
look ahead: Grandpa always tells us to look ahead and not to worry too much about the mistakes we made in the past.
爺爺總是告訴我們要向前看，不要太擔心過去犯的錯。
get ahead: If you want to get ahead in your job, you have to work hard and keep learning new things every day.
如果你想在工作上出人頭地，就必須努力工作，並且每天持續學習新事物。
straight ahead: Walk straight ahead for about five minutes, and you will see the post office on your left side.
一直往前走大約五分鐘，你就會看到郵局在你的左手邊。
the road ahead: The road ahead was dark and wet after the heavy rain, so Dad drove slowly and turned on the lights.
大雨過後前方的路又黑又濕，所以爸爸開得很慢，並且開了車燈。
be ahead of the class: Mary reads a lot of English books at home, so she is always ahead of the class in reading tests.
瑪麗在家讀很多英文書，所以她在閱讀測驗上總是在班上領先。
all day long: It rained all day long on Saturday, so we stayed home and watched three movies with hot chocolate.
星期六整天都在下雨，所以我們留在家裡，一邊喝熱巧克力一邊看了三部電影。
all over the world: Bubble tea from Taiwan is now popular all over the world, and you can find it in many countries.
來自台灣的珍珠奶茶現在在全世界都很受歡迎，你可以在許多國家找到它。
all the time: My little brother plays video games all the time, so Mom took his phone away until the test is over.
我弟弟一直在玩電動，所以媽媽把他的手機拿走，直到考試結束。
all of a sudden: We were having a picnic in the park when all of a sudden it started to rain very hard.
我們正在公園野餐，突然開始下起大雨。
all right: Are you all right after falling off your bike, or should we go to see the doctor right now?
你從腳踏車上摔下來之後還好嗎，還是我們應該現在就去看醫生？
not at all: I was not at all surprised when Kevin won the race, because he runs every morning before school.
凱文贏得賽跑時我一點也不驚訝，因為他每天早上上學前都會跑步。
all at once: The lights went out all at once during the storm, and everyone in the restaurant stopped talking for a second.
暴風雨中所有的燈突然同時熄了，餐廳裡每個人都停下來不說話了一秒。
after all: I decided not to be angry with my sister about the broken cup; after all, she is only five years old.
我決定不要為了打破的杯子生我妹妹的氣，畢竟她才五歲。
first of all: First of all, wash your hands with soap before you touch any food in the kitchen, and then help me cook.
首先，在碰廚房裡的任何食物之前先用肥皂洗手，然後再來幫我煮飯。
above all: A good student should be polite, work hard, and above all be honest with teachers and friends.
好學生應該有禮貌、努力，最重要的是對老師和朋友誠實。
all alone: My grandfather lives all alone in an old house in the mountains, so we visit him every weekend.
我爺爺獨自一人住在山上的一棟老房子，所以我們每個週末都去看他。
all in all: The trip was long, the hotel was small, and the food was strange, but all in all we had a good time.
這趟旅行很長，旅館很小，食物也很奇怪，但總而言之我們玩得很開心。
almost every day: Jenny runs in the park almost every day after school, so it is not surprising that she is so healthy.
珍妮幾乎每天放學後都在公園跑步，所以她這麼健康一點也不奇怪。
almost finished: I am almost finished with my science report, so I can watch the baseball game with you after dinner.
我的自然科學報告快做完了，所以晚餐後我可以跟你一起看棒球比賽。
almost no money: Tom has almost no money left this month because he spent it all on a new pair of basketball shoes.
湯姆這個月幾乎沒錢了，因為他把錢全花在一雙新籃球鞋上。
almost never: My father almost never eats fast food, because he says it is bad for his heart and makes him fat.
我爸爸幾乎不曾吃速食，因為他說那對心臟不好，也會讓他變胖。
almost everyone: Almost everyone in our class joined the school trip to the zoo, and only two students stayed at home.
我們班幾乎每個人都參加了去動物園的學校旅行，只有兩個學生留在家裡。
almost there: Do not stop now, because we are almost there, and you can see the top of the mountain already.
現在別停下來，因為我們快到了，你已經可以看到山頂了。
almost（幾乎）: The water in the pool was almost too cold to swim in, but we still jumped in and had fun.
游泳池的水幾乎冷得不能游，但我們還是跳進去玩得很開心。
nearly（幾乎，同 almost）: There were nearly fifty people waiting in line, and the wait was almost an hour, so we went to another shop.
有將近五十個人在排隊，而且要等幾乎一個小時，所以我們去了另一家店。
most students（大部分學生）: Most students in my school take the bus or the MRT, and almost all of them get to school before seven thirty.
我學校大部分學生搭公車或捷運，而且他們幾乎全部都在七點半前到學校。
almost all students: Almost all students in Taiwan learn English from a young age, so they can read simple English signs easily.
台灣幾乎全部學生從小就學英文，所以他們能輕鬆讀懂簡單的英文標示。
leave me alone: When my brother is angry, he goes to his room and shouts, leave me alone, so we wait until he feels better.
我哥哥生氣時會走進房間大喊別管我，所以我們就等到他心情好一點。
live alone: My grandmother has lived alone since Grandpa passed away, but her neighbors visit her every afternoon for tea.
自從爺爺過世後，奶奶就一直獨居，但她的鄰居每天下午都來找她喝茶。
let alone: My little sister cannot even boil an egg, let alone cook a whole dinner for the family.
我妹妹連煮蛋都不會，更不用說為全家煮一頓晚餐了。
go alone: It is already dark outside, so you should not go alone to the night market; wait for your brother.
外面已經天黑了，所以你不應該一個人去夜市，等你哥哥一起吧。
work alone: Some people like to work alone in a quiet room, but I think it is more fun to work with a team.
有些人喜歡在安靜的房間裡獨自工作，但我覺得跟團隊一起工作比較有趣。
alone（獨自；不帶情緒）: Jack was alone at home last night, but he did not feel sad because he had a good book to read.
傑克昨晚獨自在家，但他並不覺得難過，因為他有一本好書可以看。
lonely（寂寞的）: Many old people live alone and feel lonely after their children move away, so a phone call means a lot to them.
很多老人在孩子搬走後獨居又感到寂寞，所以一通電話對他們來說意義重大。
I feel lonely at the new school because I eat lunch alone every day, but I hope to make friends soon.
我在新學校覺得寂寞，因為我每天都獨自吃午餐，但我希望很快能交到朋友。
I live alone in a small apartment near the train station, and I cook simple dinners for myself every night.
我獨居在火車站附近的小公寓，每天晚上為自己煮簡單的晚餐。
read aloud: Our English teacher asks one student to read aloud the first page every morning before the lesson begins.
我們的英文老師每天早上上課前都會請一位學生朗讀第一頁。
think aloud: When I do hard math problems, I like to think aloud, so my brother always knows what I am doing.
我在做困難的數學題時喜歡邊想邊說，所以我哥哥總是知道我在做什麼。
laugh aloud: The joke was so funny that Peter laughed aloud in the library, and everyone turned to look at him.
那個笑話太好笑了，彼得在圖書館裡大聲笑出來，大家都轉頭看他。
say it aloud: If you want to remember the new word, say it aloud three times and then write it down in your notebook.
如果你想記住新單字，就大聲說出來三次，然後寫在筆記本上。
aloud（出聲地）: Dad reads the newspaper aloud at breakfast, so the whole family hears the news while we eat our eggs.
爸爸早餐時會出聲地讀報紙，所以全家人吃蛋時都能聽到新聞。
loud（大聲的；大聲地）: Jack does not need to read aloud, because his voice is so loud that even the teacher next door can hear him.
傑克不需要朗讀，因為他的聲音這麼大聲，連隔壁的老師都聽得到。
loudly（大聲地）: Amy read the story aloud to the class, but she spoke so loudly that the baby in the next room woke up.
艾美大聲地把故事唸給全班聽，但她講得太大聲，隔壁房間的寶寶都醒了。
speak louder: When you read aloud in class, please speak louder, because the students in the back cannot hear you.
你在課堂上朗讀時請說大聲點，因為後面的學生聽不到你。
Thank you, but I've already eaten a big lunch at school, so I do not want any more rice now.
謝謝，但我已經在學校吃過一頓豐盛的午餐了，所以我現在不想再吃飯了。
Hurry up and get dressed, because it's already ten and the movie starts at half past ten.
快點穿好衣服，因為已經十點了，電影十點半就開始。
already here: When I arrived at the bus stop in the rain, my friends were already here, waiting under a big umbrella.
當我在雨中到達公車站時，我的朋友已經到了，在一把大傘下等著。
already done: You do not need to wash the dishes tonight, because they are already done, and the kitchen is clean.
你今晚不用洗碗，因為碗已經洗好了，廚房也很乾淨。
already know: I already know the answer to this question, because our teacher taught us the same thing last week.
我早就知道這個問題的答案了，因為老師上星期教過我們同樣的東西。
already（已經；肯定句）: My brother has already finished his homework, so he is playing basketball with his friends in the park now.
我哥哥已經做完作業了，所以他現在正在公園跟朋友打籃球。
yet（尚未；否定句、問句）: I have already finished my science report, but have you finished yours yet, or do you need more time?
我已經做完自然科學報告了，但你的做完了嗎，還是你需要更多時間？
still（仍然）: It is already nine o'clock at night, but my father is still working in the office and has not eaten dinner.
已經是晚上九點了，但我爸爸仍然在辦公室工作，還沒吃晚餐。
Have you eaten yet?: Have you eaten yet, or would you like to join us, because we have already ordered too much fried chicken?
你吃了嗎，還是你想加入我們，因為我們已經點了太多炸雞？
I have not eaten yet, but my sister has already had her dinner, so let's find a restaurant for us two.
我還沒吃，但我姊姊已經吃過晚餐了，所以我們兩個去找家餐廳吧。
My brother loves this new movie about space, and I also like it, so we are going to see it again.
我哥哥很喜歡這部關於太空的新電影，我也喜歡，所以我們要再去看一次。
not only…but also: Our math teacher is not only kind but also very funny, so nobody falls asleep in his class.
我們的數學老師不但親切，而且非常有趣，所以沒有人在他的課上睡著。
also known as: Taipei 101, also known as the tallest building in Taiwan for many years, is a popular place for visitors from abroad.
台北一〇一，又名台灣多年來最高的建築，是國外遊客喜愛的地方。
Mr. Lin is a famous cook in our town, and he is also a teacher at the night school on weekends.
林先生是我們鎮上有名的廚師，週末他也是夜校的老師。
also（放動詞前）: Jenny also plays the piano very well, so she will join the music club with her good friend this year.
珍妮也鋼琴彈得很好，所以今年她會跟好朋友一起加入音樂社。
too（放句尾）: I also like chocolate ice cream, and my sister likes it, too, so Dad bought two for us at the shop.
我也喜歡巧克力冰淇淋，我姊姊也喜歡，所以爸爸在店裡買了兩個給我們。
as well（句尾）: The hotel has a big pool and a nice garden as well, and it is also very close to the beach.
這家旅館有一個大游泳池，也有一座漂亮的花園，而且它也離海邊很近。
either（否定句尾）: Jack does not eat fish, and his brother does not like it either, so Mom also cooks chicken for them every time.
傑克不吃魚，他的弟弟也不喜歡，所以媽媽每次也會煮雞肉給他們吃。
My cousin likes to play badminton, and I like it, too, so we also play together in the gym after school.
我表哥喜歡打羽毛球，我也喜歡，所以我們放學後也會一起在體育館打。
I don't like cold winter weather, and my dog doesn't like it, either, so we also stay inside by the heater.
我不喜歡寒冷的冬天天氣，我的狗也不喜歡，所以我們也待在室內的暖爐旁。
altogether twenty people: There are altogether twenty people at the birthday party tonight, so we need a bigger cake and more chairs.
今晚生日派對總共二十人，所以我們需要更大的蛋糕和更多椅子。
not altogether true: What Tom said about the new teacher is not altogether true, so do not believe everything you hear in class.
湯姆說的關於新老師的話並非完全正確，所以別相信你在班上聽到的每件事。
stop altogether: My father used to smoke every day, but he decided to stop altogether after the doctor talked to him last year.
我爸爸以前每天抽菸，但去年醫生跟他談過之後，他決定完全停止。
Riding a bike in the park is easy, but riding one on a busy street is a different thing altogether.
在公園騎腳踏車很容易，但在繁忙的街上騎就完全是另一回事了。
altogether（總共；完全）: We bought three shirts and two pairs of shoes at the night market, and we spent two thousand dollars altogether.
我們在夜市買了三件襯衫和兩雙鞋，總共花了兩千元。
all together（全部一起）: All together, the thirty students pushed the heavy school bus, and altogether they moved it about twenty meters.
三十個學生全部一起推那輛很重的校車，總共把它推動了大約二十公尺。
At the end of the school show, we sang all together on the stage, and altogether forty students were up there.
在學校表演的最後，我們在舞台上一起合唱，總共有四十個學生在台上。
The dinner for six people costs 500 dollars altogether, so each of us only needs to pay a little.
六個人的晚餐總共五百元，所以我們每個人只需要付一點。
as always: As always, Grandma made a big pot of hot soup for the whole family when we visited her on Sunday.
一如往常，我們星期日去探望奶奶時，她為全家煮了一大鍋熱湯。
not always: Expensive things are not always better, so you should compare the prices carefully before you buy anything.
貴的東西不一定比較好，所以買任何東西之前你應該仔細比較價格。
always late: Kevin is always late for the morning class, so the teacher asked him to set two alarm clocks tonight.
凱文早上的課總是遲到，所以老師叫他今晚設兩個鬧鐘。
If you do not understand the lesson, you can always ask me after class, and I will explain it again.
如果你不懂課程內容，你隨時可以下課後問我，我會再解釋一次。
for always: My grandfather and grandmother got married fifty years ago, and they promised to love each other for always on that day.
我的爺爺奶奶五十年前結婚，那天他們承諾要永遠愛對方。
always 放 be 動詞後: My mother is always busy on weekday mornings because she has to make breakfast and drive us to school.
我媽媽平日早上總是很忙，因為她得做早餐還要開車送我們上學。
always 放一般動詞前: My brother always brushes his teeth before he goes to bed, so the dentist says his teeth look great.
我哥哥睡前總是會刷牙，所以牙醫說他的牙齒看起來很棒。
He is always late for the school bus, so his mother has to drive him to school almost every morning.
他總是錯過校車，所以他媽媽幾乎每天早上都得開車送他上學。
Jason always comes late to the English club, so he often misses the first fun game of the afternoon.
傑森來英文社總是晚到，所以他常常錯過下午第一個好玩的遊戲。
not…anymore: The old movie theater near the park is not open anymore, so we have to take the MRT to see a movie.
公園附近那家老電影院不再營業了，所以我們得搭捷運去看電影。
I don't live here anymore because my family moved to Taichung last summer for my father's new job.
我不住這裡了，因為去年夏天我家為了爸爸的新工作搬去台中。
not a kid anymore: You are not a kid anymore, so you should clean your room and wash your clothes by yourself.
你不再是小孩了，所以你應該自己打掃房間和洗衣服。
can't wait anymore: The pizza smells so good that my little brother can't wait anymore, and he is already waiting at the table.
披薩聞起來太香了，我弟弟不能再等了，他已經在餐桌旁等著。
not…anymore（不再）: Mary used to play the piano every evening, but she does not practice anymore because of her busy school life.
瑪麗以前每天傍晚都彈鋼琴，但因為學校生活太忙，她不再練習了。
no longer（不再）: Mr. Wang no longer works at this school, and he does not live in our town anymore, because he moved to Kaohsiung.
王老師不再在這所學校工作，他也不住在我們鎮上了，因為他搬去高雄了。
I no longer live with my parents, and I do not go to the old school anymore, but I visit them often.
我不再跟父母住，也不再去那所舊學校了，但我常常去看他們。
not…any longer: The shop does not sell newspapers any longer, and it does not open at night anymore, so Grandpa watches news on TV.
那家店不再賣報紙了，晚上也不再開門了，所以爺爺看電視新聞。
anywhere you like: On your birthday, we can have dinner anywhere you like, so think about your favorite restaurant in town.
你生日那天，我們可以去你喜歡的任何地方吃晚餐，所以想想你在鎮上最喜歡的餐廳。
not going anywhere: It is raining hard outside, and I am not going anywhere today, so I will read a book on the sofa.
外面雨下得很大，我今天哪裡都不去，所以我會坐在沙發上看書。
anywhere else: Is there anywhere else we can buy a cheaper school bag, or is this store the only one near here?
我們還有其他任何地方可以買到比較便宜的書包嗎，還是這家店是附近唯一的一家？
can't find it anywhere: I have looked in my bag, under the bed, and on the desk, but I can't find my keys anywhere.
我找過包包裡、床底下和桌上，但到處找不到我的鑰匙。
anywhere in Taiwan: You can find a small store open all night anywhere in Taiwan, even in little towns in the mountains.
在台灣任何地方你都找得到整夜營業的小店，連山上的小鎮也有。
anywhere（否定、問句）: Did you go anywhere interesting during the winter vacation, or did you just stay at home and rest?
寒假期間你有去任何有趣的地方嗎，還是只待在家裡休息？
somewhere（肯定句）: Let's go somewhere quiet for lunch, because I cannot find anywhere near school that is not too noisy today.
我們去安靜的某個地方吃午餐吧，因為今天學校附近我找不到任何不吵的地方。
everywhere（每個地方）: After the heavy rain, there was water everywhere, and we could not find anywhere dry to sit in the park.
大雨過後到處都是水，我們在公園裡找不到任何乾的地方可以坐。
nowhere（沒有地方）: The restaurants were all full on Mother's Day, so there was nowhere to sit, and we could not find a table anywhere.
母親節那天餐廳全都滿了，所以沒有地方可以坐，我們到處找不到桌子。
live apart: My parents live apart now because my father works in Taipei and my mother takes care of Grandma in Tainan.
我父母現在分開住，因為爸爸在台北工作，媽媽在台南照顧奶奶。
fall apart: This old chair is so weak that it will fall apart if a heavy person sits on it, so be careful.
這張舊椅子太不牢了，要是有個很重的人坐上去，它會散掉，所以要小心。
take apart: My brother likes to take apart old radios and clocks to see how they work, and then he puts them back together.
我哥哥喜歡把舊收音機和時鐘拆開看看它們怎麼運作，然後再把它們裝回去。
tell A and B apart: The two sisters look so much alike that even their teacher cannot tell Amy and Annie apart in class.
這兩姊妹長得太像了，連她們的老師在課堂上都分辨不出艾美與安妮。
far apart: My good friend Amy and I live far apart now, but we still talk on the phone every Saturday night.
我和好朋友艾美現在住得相距很遠，但我們每個星期六晚上仍然講電話。
two meters apart: The teacher asked us to stand two meters apart in the playground, so the line looked very long.
老師要我們在操場上站得相距兩公尺，所以隊伍看起來非常長。
apart from: Apart from a little rain on the first day, the weather was perfect during our whole trip to Kenting.
除了第一天下了一點雨之外，我們整趟墾丁之旅的天氣都很完美。
look around: When we got to the new shopping center, we decided to look around first before buying anything for Mom.
我們到新購物中心時，決定先四處看看，再買東西給媽媽。
turn around: I heard someone call my name on the street, so I turned around and saw my old friend from the first grade.
我在街上聽到有人叫我的名字，所以轉身一看，看到了我一年級的老朋友。
around the corner: Summer vacation is just around the corner, and all the students are already making plans for the beach.
暑假就在轉角即將到來，所有學生都已經在計畫去海邊了。
around the world: People around the world enjoy watching the Olympic Games on TV, and they cheer for their own teams.
全世界的人都喜歡在電視上看奧運，並為自己國家的隊伍加油。
around ten o'clock: The movie starts at around ten o'clock tonight, so let's have dinner first and then walk to the theater.
電影今晚十點左右開始，所以我們先吃晚餐，然後走路去電影院。
show you around: When you come to Tainan this weekend, I will show you around the old streets and the famous night market.
這個週末你來台南時，我會帶你參觀老街和有名的夜市。
hang around: Some students like to hang around the park after school instead of going straight home to study for tests.
有些學生放學後喜歡在公園閒晃，而不是直接回家準備考試。
all year around: In the south of Taiwan, the weather is warm all year around, so people can swim in the sea in December.
在台灣南部，天氣一年到頭都很暖和，所以人們十二月也能在海裡游泳。
the other way around: I thought my sister broke the window, but it was the other way around; she was the one who found the glass.
我以為是我姊姊打破窗戶的，但其實相反，她是發現玻璃碎片的人。
as usual: As usual, my father got up at six, made coffee, and read the newspaper before anyone else woke up.
照常，我爸爸六點起床，泡了咖啡，在其他人醒來之前先看了報紙。
as well: My sister is good at singing, and she can dance as well, so she wants to join the school show.
我姊姊很會唱歌，也會跳舞，所以她想參加學校表演。
as well as: At the party, we ate pizza and fried chicken as well as a big chocolate cake that Grandma made.
派對上我們吃了披薩和炸雞，以及奶奶做的一個大巧克力蛋糕。
as soon as possible: Please send me the photos from the school trip as soon as possible, because I want to show them to my parents.
請盡快把學校旅行的照片傳給我，因為我想拿給我爸媽看。
as a result: Jack did not study for the English test at all, and as a result he got the lowest score in the class.
傑克完全沒有準備英文考試，結果他拿到全班最低的分數。
such as: My mother likes to cook simple dishes, such as fried rice, vegetable soup, and eggs with tomatoes.
我媽媽喜歡做簡單的菜，例如炒飯、蔬菜湯和番茄炒蛋。
as for me: My brother wants to go to the mountains this weekend, but as for me, I would rather stay home and sleep.
我哥哥這個週末想去山上，但至於我，我寧願待在家裡睡覺。
as if: The little boy talks about dinosaurs as if he had seen them with his own eyes in a real forest.
那個小男孩談起恐龍，好像他曾在真的森林裡親眼看過它們一樣。
as long as: Mom said we can keep the little dog as long as we walk him every day and clean up after him.
媽媽說只要我們每天帶小狗散步並清理它的便便，我們就可以養它。
as far as I know: As far as I know, the new library opens at nine in the morning, but you can call them to be sure.
就我所知，新圖書館早上九點開門，但你可以打電話給他們確認一下。
as…as: My little brother is already as tall as our mother, and he is still growing fast every month.
我弟弟已經和我們媽媽一樣高了，而且他每個月還在快速長高。
not as…as: This new phone is not as expensive as the one I bought last year, but it takes much better pictures.
這支新手機不如我去年買的那支貴，但拍照好很多。
as tall as his father: Peter is only thirteen, but he is already as tall as his father, so he has to buy new clothes often.
彼得才十三歲，但他已經和他爸爸一樣高了，所以他得常常買新衣服。
twice as big as: The new gym at our school is twice as big as the old one, so two teams can play basketball together.
我們學校的新體育館是舊的兩倍大，所以兩隊可以一起打籃球。
as much as possible: Before the big test, Jenny tried to read as much as possible, and she even studied on the bus every morning.
大考前，珍妮試著盡可能多讀書，她甚至每天早上在公車上也讀。
as early as possible: On the day of the trip, please come to the school gate as early as possible, because the bus leaves at seven.
旅行當天請越早越好來到校門口，因為公車七點就出發。
put aside: I put aside my homework for a while and helped my mother cook dinner, because she looked really tired.
我把作業先放到一邊一會兒，去幫媽媽煮晚餐，因為她看起來真的很累。
step aside: The old man asked the children to step aside so that the people with heavy bags could get off the bus first.
老人請孩子們站到旁邊，讓提著重包包的人先下公車。
set aside some money: My grandmother told me to set aside some money every month, so I can buy a new bike next year.
我奶奶告訴我每個月要存一些錢，這樣明年我就可以買一輛新腳踏車。
aside from: Aside from the long drive, the trip to the beach was wonderful, and the children swam all afternoon.
除了開車時間很長之外，這趟海邊之旅很棒，孩子們整個下午都在游泳。
right away: When I saw my little sister fall off her bike, I ran to her right away to see if she was hurt.
當我看到妹妹從腳踏車上摔下來時，我馬上跑過去看她有沒有受傷。
far away: My grandfather and grandmother live far away in the mountains, so it takes us about three hours to drive there.
我的爺爺奶奶住在很遠的山上，所以我們開車到那裡大約要三個小時。
go away: The dog kept barking at the cat, but the cat did not go away and just sat quietly on the wall.
那隻狗一直對貓吠叫，但貓沒有走開，只是安靜地坐在牆上。
run away: The thief tried to run away with the woman's bag, but two young men caught him at the corner.
小偷想帶著那女人的包包逃走，但兩個年輕人在轉角抓住了他。
put away: Please put away your books and pencils, because dinner is ready and we need the table to eat.
請把你的書和鉛筆收好，因為晚餐準備好了，我們需要用餐桌吃飯。
give away: My sister decided to give away her old toys to the children in the hospital before the Christmas holidays.
我姊姊決定在聖誕假期前把她的舊玩具送掉，給醫院裡的孩子們。
throw away: Do not throw away the empty bottles, because we can wash them and use them to grow small plants.
不要把空瓶子丟掉，因為我們可以洗乾淨，用它們來種小植物。
take away: The restaurant was too crowded, so we ordered two bowls of beef noodles to take away and ate them at home.
餐廳太擠了，所以我們點了兩碗牛肉麵外帶，回家吃。
stay away from: The doctor told my father to stay away from sweet drinks and fried food if he wants to lose weight.
醫生告訴我爸爸，如果想減重，就要遠離含糖飲料和炸的食物。
pass away: My grandfather passed away last winter at the age of ninety, and we all miss his funny stories very much.
我爺爺去年冬天過世，享年九十歲，我們都非常想念他有趣的故事。
get away: After a busy month of tests, my family wants to get away to the beach for a few quiet days.
經過忙碌的考試月，我家想去海邊度假，過幾天安靜的日子。
two miles away: The nearest train station is two miles away from our house, so my father drives me there every morning.
最近的火車站離我們家兩英里遠，所以我爸爸每天早上開車送我去。
a week away: The big English test is only a week away, so I need to review all the new words every night.
重要的英文考試還有一週，所以我每晚都需要複習所有的新單字。
come back: My father promised to come back from Japan before my birthday, so I hope his plane will not be late.
我爸爸答應在我生日前從日本回來，所以我希望他的飛機不會延誤。
go back: After living in the city for five years, my aunt decided to go back to her small town by the sea.
在城市住了五年之後，我阿姨決定回去她海邊的小鎮。
give back: You should give back the book to the library this week, or you will have to pay some money for being late.
你應該這週把書歸還給圖書館，否則你就得付一些逾期的錢。
call back: Mom was busy cooking dinner when Aunt Lily called, so she promised to call her back after we finished eating.
媽媽在煮晚餐時莉莉阿姨打電話來，所以她答應我們吃完飯後再回電給她。
pay back: Tom borrowed two hundred dollars from me last week, and he said he would pay me back on Friday.
湯姆上星期向我借了兩百元，他說星期五會把錢還給我。
take back: I said something mean to my sister this morning, and now I really want to take it back and say sorry.
我今天早上對姊姊說了很難聽的話，現在我真的很想收回那些話並道歉。
look back: When my grandfather looks back on his school days, he always smiles and tells us funny stories about his friends.
當爺爺回顧他的學生時代時，他總是微笑著跟我們說他朋友們的趣事。
back and forth: The little boy ran back and forth between the kitchen and the living room because he was so excited about the party.
那個小男孩在廚房和客廳之間來回跑，因為他對派對感到非常興奮。
back then: Back then, nobody had a phone, so my parents wrote letters to each other every week and waited many days for an answer.
那時候沒有人有電話，所以我爸媽每個星期都寫信給對方，然後等好多天才收到回信。
back home: After studying in Taipei for three years, my cousin finally went back home to see his old friends in Tainan.
在臺北念了三年書之後，我表哥終於回家鄉臺南去看他的老朋友。
back to school: Summer vacation is over, and the stores are full of parents buying bags and pencils because it is time to go back to school.
暑假結束了，商店裡擠滿了買書包和鉛筆的家長，因為開學的時候到了。
get back to: The teacher told us she was busy now but would get back to our questions about the trip after lunch.
老師告訴我們她現在很忙，但午餐後會再回覆我們關於旅行的問題。
sit back: On Sunday afternoon, Dad likes to sit back on the sofa with a cup of tea and listen to old songs.
星期天下午，爸爸喜歡靜靜坐在沙發上，喝杯茶，聽老歌。
be back: Please wait here for a few minutes because the doctor will be back as soon as he finishes his phone call.
請在這裡等幾分鐘，因為醫生一講完電話就會回來了。
way back: Way back when my grandmother was a girl, most people in her village walked to school because there were no buses.
很久以前，當我奶奶還是個小女孩時，她村子裡大多數人都走路上學，因為那時沒有公車。
walk backward: In the game, you have to walk backward across the room without looking, and everyone laughs when someone falls.
在這個遊戲中，你必須不看路、往後走穿過房間，當有人跌倒時大家都會笑。
look backward: Do not look backward when you ride your bike down the hill, or you may hit a tree or a stone.
騎腳踏車下坡時不要往後看，否則你可能會撞到樹或石頭。
move backward: The driver had to move backward slowly because a big truck was blocking the narrow road in front of him.
司機必須慢慢後退，因為一輛大卡車擋住了他前面那條狹窄的路。
backward and forward: The baby laughed a lot as her father pushed the swing backward and forward in the park on a sunny afternoon.
在一個晴朗的下午，爸爸在公園裡把鞦韆前後來回推動，小寶寶笑得很開心。
count backward: Before the new year begins, people on TV count backward from ten to one, and then everyone shouts Happy New Year.
新年開始前，電視上的人從十倒數到一，然後大家一起大喊新年快樂。
backward（向後）: The word backward tells you the direction, so when the teacher says step backward, you should move toward the wall behind you.
backward 這個字告訴你方向，所以當老師說往後退時，你應該往你後面的牆移動。
forward（向前）: Backward and forward are directions, so when the coach said run forward, the players ran toward the goal, not away from it.
backward 和 forward 都是方向，所以當教練說向前跑時，球員們朝球門跑去，而不是跑開。
step backward: When the big dog came near, the little girl took a step backward and quickly held her mother's hand.
當大狗靠近時，小女孩往後退了一步，趕快握住媽媽的手。
the day before: We had a big test on Monday, so I studied until midnight the day before and felt very tired in class.
我們星期一有一個大考，所以我前一天讀書到半夜，上課時覺得非常累。
the night before: Jenny could not sleep well the night before her first trip to Japan because she was too excited about it.
珍妮在第一次去日本旅行的前一晚睡不好，因為她對這次旅行太興奮了。
never before: I have never before seen so much snow in my life, so I ran outside and took many pictures.
我一生中以前從未看過這麼多雪，所以我跑到外面拍了很多照片。
as before: The restaurant changed its name last month, but the noodles taste as good as before, so we still eat there every week.
那家餐廳上個月改了名字，但麵條還是和以前一樣好吃，所以我們仍然每個星期去吃。
before long: It is raining hard now, but the weather report says the sun will come out before long, so let's wait a little.
現在雨下得很大，但天氣預報說不久之後太陽就會出來，所以我們稍等一下吧。
long before: My grandfather and grandmother got married long before I was born, and they still hold hands when they walk in the park.
我爺爺和奶奶在我出生前很久就結婚了，他們在公園散步時仍然會牽手。
before（之前；可接子句）: Before you go out to play basketball with your friends, you must finish your homework and clean your room.
在你出去和朋友打籃球之前，你必須先做完功課並打掃房間。
ago（…之前；只接時間）: I moved to Taipei three years ago, and before that I lived in a small town near the sea with my grandmother.
我三年前搬到臺北，在那之前我和奶奶住在海邊的一個小鎮。
When my friend showed me the movie, I told him that I had seen it before, but I watched it again anyway.
當朋友給我看這部電影時，我告訴他我以前看過了，但我還是又看了一次。
I saw that red bike in the shop two days ago, and I had never seen such a beautiful bike before that day.
我兩天前在店裡看過那輛紅色腳踏車，在那天之前我從未看過這麼漂亮的腳踏車。
This little restaurant near our school has really good noodles, and besides, it is cheap, so students love eating there.
我們學校附近這間小餐廳的麵很好吃，而且它很便宜，所以學生們很愛去那裡吃。
besides me: Three other students besides me got full marks on the English test, so the teacher gave all of us a small gift.
除了我之外，還有三個學生英文考試拿滿分，所以老師給我們每個人一個小禮物。
What else, besides this?: We already have eggs, milk, and bread in the basket, so what else do we need to buy besides this?
籃子裡已經有蛋、牛奶和麵包了，那除了這個我們還需要買什麼？
besides（此外，附加）: Besides English and math, Amy also studies music and art on Saturdays, so she is always very busy.
除了英文和數學之外，艾美星期六還學音樂和美術，所以她總是很忙。
except（除了，排除）: Our store is open every day except Monday, and besides noodles, we also sell rice, soup, and cold drinks.
我們的店除了星期一不開之外每天都營業，而且除了麵之外，我們還賣飯、湯和冷飲。
beside（在旁邊）: At the party, Sam sat beside the window and talked to a new friend about his favorite baseball team all night.
在派對上，山姆坐在窗邊，整晚跟一位新朋友聊他最喜歡的棒球隊。
Everyone in our class came to the party besides Tom, so there were more than thirty people in the small room.
除了湯姆以外，我們班上的每個人也都來參加派對了，所以小房間裡有三十多人。
Everyone came to practice except Tom, who was sick, and besides practice, we also had a short team meeting.
除了生病的湯姆以外，大家都來練習了，而且除了練習之外，我們還開了一個簡短的隊伍會議。
come close: The shy cat finally came close to me when I sat still on the floor and held out a small piece of fish.
當我靜靜地坐在地板上，拿著一小塊魚時，那隻害羞的貓終於靠近我了。
close by: My grandmother lives close by, so I can walk to her house in five minutes and have dinner with her every weekend.
我奶奶住在附近，所以我可以走五分鐘到她家，每個週末都和她一起吃晚餐。
close to the station: We found a nice hotel close to the station, so it was easy to catch the early train the next morning.
我們找到一間靠近車站的好旅館，所以第二天早上很容易趕上早班火車。
close to a hundred: Close to a hundred students joined the school sports day this year, so the games lasted almost three hours.
今年接近一百名學生參加了學校運動會，所以比賽持續了將近三個小時。
stay close: The night market was very crowded, so Mom told my little brother to stay close and not let go of her hand.
夜市非常擁擠，所以媽媽叫我弟弟待在附近，不要放開她的手。
close together: It was so cold on the mountain that the five of us sat close together around the fire and shared one blanket.
山上非常冷，所以我們五個人緊靠在一起圍著火坐，共用一條毯子。
close（接近地）: The word close tells us about distance, so when my teacher said sit close, I moved my chair next to hers.
close 這個字是在說距離，所以當老師說靠近坐時，我把椅子移到她的椅子旁邊。
closely（仔細地；密切地）: The word closely tells us about the way we do something, so the doctor watched the sick child closely all night.
closely 這個字是在說做事的方式，所以醫生整晚仔細地觀察那個生病的孩子。
It is very dark on this road, so please stand close to me and hold the flashlight while we wait for the bus.
這條路非常暗，所以請站靠近我，在我們等公車時拿好手電筒。
If you look closely at this old picture, you can see my grandfather standing in the back row with a big smile.
如果你仔細看這張老照片，你可以看到我爺爺站在後排，臉上帶著大大的微笑。
daily life: Learning English is useful in daily life because we see English words on signs, menus, and computers every day.
學英文在日常生活中很有用，因為我們每天都在招牌、菜單和電腦上看到英文字。
a daily newspaper: My father reads a daily newspaper at breakfast every morning, and he likes to talk about the news with us.
我爸爸每天早上吃早餐時都看日報，而且他喜歡跟我們聊新聞。
twice daily: The doctor told my grandmother to take this small white pill twice daily, once after breakfast and once after dinner.
醫生叫我奶奶每天兩次吃這顆小白藥丸，早餐後一次，晚餐後一次。
daily use: These cheap cups and plates are for daily use, and we keep the beautiful ones for special days like New Year.
這些便宜的杯盤是日常使用的，漂亮的那些我們留到新年這類特別的日子才用。
exercise daily: My uncle is sixty years old, but he looks young and strong because he exercises daily in the park near his house.
我叔叔六十歲了，但他看起來年輕又強壯，因為他每天在家附近的公園運動。
daily（每天）: We can use daily in two ways, so my father takes a daily walk, and we can also say that he walks daily.
daily 有兩種用法，所以我爸爸有每天的散步習慣，我們也可以說他每天散步。
every day（每天；兩字）: Every day is two words, so I can say that I drink milk every day, which means the same as daily.
every day 是兩個字，所以我可以說我每天喝牛奶，意思和 daily 一樣。
everyday（日常的；一字）: Everyday is one word that describes things, so we say everyday clothes, but we cannot use it instead of daily to say how often.
everyday 是一個字，用來形容事物，所以我們說日常的衣服，但不能用它代替 daily 來說多常做。
everyday English: Our teacher says everyday English is more useful than big words from books, so we practice daily by ordering food in English.
我們老師說日常英語比書裡的大字更有用，所以我們每天練習用英文點餐。
deep down: Lisa says she does not care about the game, but deep down she really hopes her team will win the final.
麗莎說她不在乎這場比賽，但在內心深處她真的希望她的隊能贏得決賽。
dig deep: The math problem was very hard, but Kevin had to dig deep and think for a long time before he found the answer.
這道數學題非常難，但凱文必須深入挖掘、用心思考很久才找到答案。
deep in thought: My brother was deep in thought at the dinner table, so he did not hear Mom calling his name three times.
我哥哥在餐桌前沉思，所以媽媽叫了他的名字三次他都沒聽到。
deep into the night: The two friends talked deep into the night about their dreams, and they finally went to sleep at three in the morning.
這兩個朋友聊他們的夢想直到深夜，最後凌晨三點才去睡覺。
breathe deep: Before the big race began, the coach told us to breathe deep, close our eyes, and think about running well.
大賽開始前，教練叫我們深呼吸、閉上眼睛，想著好好地跑。
deep in the forest: Deep in the forest, we found a small clear lake, and there were many birds singing in the tall trees around it.
在森林深處，我們發現一個清澈的小湖，周圍的大樹上有許多鳥在唱歌。
deep（深深地；具體）: When deep tells about a real distance, it does not need an extra ending, so the dog dug deep in the garden and made a hole.
deep 指實際深度時不用加字尾，所以狗在花園裡深深地挖，挖出一個洞。
deeply（深深地；抽象）: When we talk about strong feelings, we use deeply instead of deep, so I felt deeply sad when my friend moved away.
談到強烈的情感時，我們用 deeply 而不是 deep，所以當朋友搬走時我深深地感到難過。
deeply moved: Everyone in the room was deeply moved by the old man's story about his lost dog, and some people even cried.
房間裡每個人都被那位老先生講他走失的狗的故事深深感動，有些人甚至哭了。
deeply in love: In the movie, the young prince falls deeply in love with a poor girl, and his parents are not happy about it.
在電影中，年輕的王子深深愛上一個貧窮的女孩，他的父母對此很不高興。
calm down: When my little sister lost her favorite toy, Mom asked her to calm down first and then helped her look for it.
當我妹妹弄丟她最喜歡的玩具時，媽媽叫她先冷靜下來，然後幫她找。
sit down: After standing on the bus for one hour, Grandpa was happy to sit down on a bench and rest his tired legs.
在公車上站了一個小時後，爺爺很高興能在長椅上坐下，讓疲累的雙腿休息。
slow down: The road was wet after the rain, so Dad had to slow down and drive more carefully around every corner.
雨後路很濕，所以爸爸必須慢下來，在每個轉角都開得更小心。
turn down: Grandma turned down the TV because the baby was sleeping, and she also turned down my idea of having a loud party.
奶奶把電視調小因為寶寶在睡覺，她也拒絕了我辦一場熱鬧派對的提議。
write down: Please write down the teacher's phone number in your notebook, or you may forget it before you get home tonight.
請把老師的電話號碼寫在你的筆記本上，否則你今晚到家之前可能就忘了。
break down: Our old car broke down on the way to the beach, so we had to wait two hours for help under the hot sun.
我們的老車在去海邊的路上故障了，所以我們必須在大太陽下等了兩個小時等人來幫忙。
cut down: The doctor told my father to cut down on sweet drinks and eat more vegetables if he wanted to be healthier.
醫生告訴我爸爸，如果他想更健康，就要減少喝甜飲料並多吃蔬菜。
let sb. down: I promised to help Peter with his science project, so I cannot let him down even though I am very busy this week.
我答應幫彼得做自然科專題，所以即使我這星期很忙，也不能讓他失望。
look down on: A good student should never look down on friends who get low grades, because everyone has something they are good at.
好學生永遠不應該看不起成績低的朋友，因為每個人都有自己擅長的事。
put down: The box was too heavy for the little girl, so her father asked her to put it down and rest for a while.
那個箱子對小女孩來說太重了，所以她爸爸叫她把它放下，休息一下。
get down to: After playing games all afternoon, Jack finally turned off the computer and got down to his English homework at nine.
玩了一整個下午的遊戲後，傑克終於在九點關掉電腦，開始認真做英文功課。
up and down: The excited children jumped up and down on the bed when they heard that the family was going to the zoo.
當孩子們聽到全家要去動物園時，他們興奮地在床上上上下下地跳。
feel down: Mary felt down after she failed the test, so her friends took her out for ice cream to cheer her up.
瑪莉考試不及格後心情低落，所以她的朋友帶她去吃冰淇淋讓她開心起來。
come down with: Many students came down with a cold after the rainy sports day, so half of the seats in our class were empty on Monday.
在下雨的運動會之後，許多學生感冒了，所以星期一我們班有一半的座位是空的。
price goes down: When the price of fruit goes down in summer, my mother always buys a lot of mangoes and makes cold drinks for us.
夏天水果價格下跌時，我媽媽總是買很多芒果，為我們做冷飲。
go downstairs: Every morning I go downstairs to have breakfast with my family before I brush my teeth and get ready for school.
每天早上我都下樓和家人一起吃早餐，然後刷牙、準備上學。
come downstairs: Dinner is ready, so please come downstairs now, or the soup will get cold and your father will not be happy.
晚餐準備好了，請現在就下樓來，否則湯會變冷，你爸爸會不高興。
the family downstairs: The family downstairs has a new baby, so we try to be quiet at night and never play loud music.
樓下那家人有個新生寶寶，所以我們晚上盡量保持安靜，從不播放大聲的音樂。
wait downstairs: My friends will wait downstairs at seven, so I have to finish my dinner quickly and change my clothes.
我的朋友們七點會在樓下等，所以我必須趕快吃完晚餐並換衣服。
go downstairs（不加 to）: We say go downstairs without the word to, so my teacher corrected me when I said I would go to downstairs.
我們說 go downstairs 時不加 to，所以當我說 go to downstairs 時，老師糾正了我。
go upstairs: Grandma lives on the first floor, so we go downstairs to eat with her and then go upstairs to our rooms to sleep.
奶奶住在一樓，所以我們下樓和她一起吃飯，然後上樓回我們的房間睡覺。
live upstairs: An old lady and her little dog live upstairs, and when she comes downstairs, she often brings us cookies on Sunday afternoons.
一位老太太和她的小狗住在樓上，她下樓時常常在星期天下午帶餅乾來給我們。
run downstairs: When the children heard the ice cream truck outside, they ran downstairs so fast that they almost fell on the steps.
當孩子們聽到外面冰淇淋車的聲音時，他們跑下樓跑得太快，差點在階梯上跌倒。
early in the morning: Early in the morning, before the sun comes up, my grandfather walks to the park to exercise with his old friends.
一大早，太陽還沒出來之前，我爺爺就走到公園和他的老朋友們一起運動。
get up early: On school days I have to get up early at six, so I always go to bed before ten at night.
上學日我必須六點早起，所以我晚上總是十點前就睡覺。
early bird: My sister is an early bird who finishes her homework before breakfast, but I like to stay up late and sleep in.
我姊姊是個早起的人，她在早餐前就做完功課，但我喜歡熬夜、晚起。
an early train: We took an early train to Tainan on Saturday, so we had the whole day to visit the old temples and night markets.
我們星期六搭早班車去臺南，所以有整整一天可以去參觀古老的廟和夜市。
arrive early: Students who arrive early at the test center can find their seats slowly and feel less nervous before the test begins.
提早到考場的學生可以慢慢找座位，在考試開始前比較不會緊張。
early on: Early on, I thought learning the guitar would be easy, but after a few weeks I found out it takes a lot of practice.
一開始我以為學吉他會很容易，但幾個星期後我發現這需要很多練習。
early（早）: Early does not change its form, so we can talk about an early bus and also say that Grandpa always gets up early.
early 形容詞與副詞同形，所以我們可以說早班公車，也可以說爺爺總是早起。
soon（不久；很快）: Early means before the usual time, but soon means a short time from now, so dinner will be ready soon if Mom cooks early.
early 是指比平常時間早，而 soon 是指從現在起不久，所以如果媽媽早點煮，晚餐很快就會好。
fast（快速）: Fast is about speed and early is about time, so a fast runner may still arrive late if he does not leave home early.
fast 是指速度而 early 是指時間，所以一個跑得快的人如果不早點出門，還是可能遲到。
The movie starts at seven, so please come early if you want to buy popcorn and find a good seat together.
電影七點開始，所以如果你想買爆米花並一起找到好座位，請早點來。
Thank you for the lovely dinner, and I hope to see you soon, maybe at the school picnic early next month.
謝謝你美好的晚餐，希望很快再見到你，也許就在下個月初的學校野餐。
When Amy said she did not like the long boring movie at all, her little brother quickly added, Me either.
當艾美說她一點也不喜歡那部又長又無聊的電影時，她弟弟很快接著說：我也不喜歡。
either way: We can take the bus or the train to the beach, and either way we will get there before noon.
我們可以搭公車或火車去海邊，不管哪一種，我們都會在中午前到。
either of them: Both of these dresses look nice on you, so you can choose either of them, and I will pay for it.
這兩件洋裝你穿都好看，所以你可以選它們兩件之中任何一件，我來付錢。
on either side: There are tall green trees on either side of the road, so it feels cool even on hot summer afternoons.
馬路兩邊都有高大的綠樹，所以即使在炎熱的夏日午後也覺得涼爽。
either you or I: Either you or I have to stay home with Grandma tonight, so let's decide quickly before the others leave.
今晚不是你就是我必須留在家裡陪奶奶，所以我們在其他人出門前快點決定吧。
not…either（也不）: In a negative sentence we put either at the end, so I can say that I do not like fish, and my sister does not, either.
否定句句尾要用 either，所以我可以說我不喜歡魚，我姊姊也不喜歡。
too（也；肯定句）: In a positive sentence we use too at the end, so when Peter said he loves basketball, I said I love it too, not either.
肯定句句尾用 too，所以當彼得說他愛籃球時，我說我也愛，而不是用 either。
either…or（不是…就是）: For dinner tonight, we can either cook noodles at home or go out for pizza, but we cannot do both.
今晚的晚餐我們不是在家煮麵，就是出去吃披薩，但不能兩個都做。
neither…nor（既不…也不）: My grandfather can neither read nor write English, but he can still understand a little when he watches TV, so he does not use either.
我爺爺既不會讀也不會寫英文，但他看電視時還是能聽懂一點，所以他不用 either。
My brother cannot swim, and I cannot swim, either, so our parents decided to send both of us to a swim class this summer.
我哥哥不會游泳，我也不會游泳，所以我們的父母決定今年夏天送我們兩個去上游泳課。
something else: This soup has too much salt for me, so could you bring me something else from the kitchen, like a bowl of rice?
這碗湯對我來說太鹹了，所以你可以從廚房拿點其他東西給我嗎，比如一碗飯？
someone else: That is not my bag because mine is blue, so it must belong to someone else in our class.
那不是我的包包，因為我的是藍色的，所以它一定是我們班上別人的。
anything else?: The waiter brought our drinks and asked with a smile, Anything else, or are you ready to order your food now?
服務生送來我們的飲料，微笑著問：還要別的嗎？還是你們現在準備好點餐了？
nothing else: I have finished all my homework, and there is nothing else to do tonight, so may I play games for an hour?
我已經做完全部功課了，今晚沒有別的事要做，所以我可以玩一小時的遊戲嗎？
or else: You need to leave the house before seven, or else you will miss the school bus and be late for class.
你必須七點前出門，否則你會錯過校車而上課遲到。
what else: We have already packed our clothes, shoes, and books for the trip, so what else should we put in the bag?
我們已經把旅行要用的衣服、鞋子和書打包好了，那還有什麼要放進袋子裡？
somewhere else: This restaurant is full and very noisy tonight, so let's go somewhere else for dinner, maybe the noodle shop around the corner.
這家餐廳今晚客滿而且很吵，所以我們去其他地方吃晚餐吧，也許去轉角那家麵店。
everyone else: Everyone else in the class has finished the test, but Kevin is still working on the last question with a worried face.
班上其他每個人都寫完考卷了，但凱文還帶著擔心的表情在寫最後一題。
Who else?: Lisa and Jack are coming to my birthday party, but who else should I invite so that we have enough people for games?
麗莎和傑克會來我的生日派對，但我還應該邀請誰，這樣我們才有足夠的人玩遊戲？
good enough: My drawing is not perfect, but my art teacher says it is good enough to put on the wall for the school show.
我的畫不完美，但美術老師說它夠好了，可以放在牆上參加學校的展覽。
old enough to: My brother is now old enough to ride his bike to school alone, but Mom still worries about him every morning.
我哥哥現在年紀夠大，可以自己騎腳踏車上學了，但媽媽每天早上還是為他擔心。
enough money: I have saved money for six months, so now I have enough money to buy the new game I have wanted.
我存錢存了六個月，所以現在我有夠多的錢可以買那個我一直想要的新遊戲。
After the dog ate my shoes for the third time this month, Dad looked at it and said, Enough is enough.
這個月狗第三次咬壞我的鞋子後，爸爸看著它說：夠了就是夠了。
That's enough!: The two boys kept fighting over the ball until their mother shouted, That's enough, and sent them both to their rooms.
兩個男孩一直為了球爭吵，直到他們的媽媽大喊「夠了！」並把他們兩個都趕回房間。
more than enough: Grandma cooked more than enough food for the party, so every guest took a box of dumplings home after the party.
奶奶為派對煮的食物綽綽有餘，所以每位客人派對後都帶了一盒水餃回家。
sure enough: The weather report said it would rain in the afternoon, and sure enough, big drops started falling just after lunch.
天氣預報說下午會下雨，果然，午餐後不久大雨滴就開始落下來了。
adj. + enough to V: The water in the pool was warm enough to swim in, so the kids jumped in and played with joy for two hours.
游泳池裡的水夠溫暖可以游泳，所以孩子們跳進去開心地玩了兩個小時。
tall enough to reach: My little sister is finally tall enough to reach the cookies on the top shelf, so now Mom hides them somewhere else.
我妹妹終於高到可以拿到最上層架子上的餅乾，所以現在媽媽把餅乾藏在別的地方。
enough + n. + to V: We do not have enough time to walk to the station, so we should take a taxi if we want to catch the train.
我們沒有足夠的時間走路到車站，所以如果想趕上火車，我們應該搭計程車。
not fast enough to win: Tom practiced hard for the race, but he was still not fast enough to win, so he will try again next year.
湯姆為比賽努力練習，但他還是不夠快，無法贏，所以他明年會再試一次。
enough 放形容詞後: Remember that enough comes after words like big or tall, so we say the room is big enough, not the room is enough big.
記得 enough 要放在 big 或 tall 這類形容詞之後，所以我們說房間夠大時是 big enough，而不是 enough big。
enough 放名詞前: When enough is used with things like chairs or money, it comes first, so we say enough chairs for everyone, not chairs enough.
enough 和椅子、錢這類名詞一起用時要放在前面，所以我們說給每個人足夠的椅子時是 enough chairs，而不是 chairs enough。
especially for you: Grandma baked this chocolate cake especially for you because she knows it is your favorite and today is your birthday.
奶奶特別為你烤了這個巧克力蛋糕，因為她知道那是你最喜歡的，而且今天是你的生日。
especially in summer: Taipei is very hot and wet, especially in summer, so many people carry a small towel and a bottle of water.
臺北非常熱又潮濕，特別是在夏天，所以很多人會帶一條小毛巾和一瓶水。
I like all kinds of fruit, especially apples, so my mother buys a big bag of them every week at the market.
我喜歡各種水果，尤其是蘋果，所以我媽媽每個星期都在市場買一大袋。
not especially: I was not especially hungry after the big lunch, so I only had a small bowl of soup for dinner.
吃了豐盛的午餐後我不特別餓，所以晚餐我只喝了一小碗湯。
especially（尤其）: We use especially to point out one thing from a group, so I enjoy sports, especially basketball with my friends after school.
我們用 especially 強調一群事物中的其中之一，所以我喜歡運動，尤其是放學後和朋友打籃球。
specially（專門地）: Specially is different from especially because it means for one purpose, so this chair was specially made for my grandfather's bad back.
specially 和 especially 不同，它是指為了特定目的，所以這張椅子是專門為我爺爺不好的背部做的。
made specially for kids: These small cups and plates were made specially for kids, so they are light and colorful, and children, especially babies, love them.
這些小杯盤是專為孩子做的，所以它們很輕、顏色鮮豔，而且孩子們，尤其是嬰兒，都很喜歡。
especially when it rains: Riding a bike to school can be dangerous, especially when it rains, because the roads become wet and cars cannot stop quickly.
騎腳踏車上學可能很危險，尤其是下雨時，因為路會變濕，車子無法很快停下來。
even better: The pizza at this new shop is good, but the one at my uncle's restaurant is even better, so we go there more often.
這家新店的披薩很好吃，但我叔叔餐廳的披薩甚至更好，所以我們比較常去那裡。
even if: We will go hiking on Sunday even if it rains, so remember to bring a raincoat and a pair of old shoes.
即使下雨我們星期天還是會去爬山，所以記得帶雨衣和一雙舊鞋。
even though: Even though Jenny was very tired after the game, she still helped her mother wash the dishes and clean the kitchen.
雖然珍妮比賽後非常累，她還是幫媽媽洗碗和打掃廚房。
even so: The weather was cold and windy that day, but even so, hundreds of people came to the park to see the flowers.
那天天氣又冷又颳風，但即便如此，還是有好幾百人來到公園看花。
not even one: I looked for my favorite cookies in three stores, but I could not find even one box, so I went home sad.
我在三家店找我最喜歡的餅乾，但連一盒也找不到，所以我難過地回家了。
even now: My grandmother moved to the city twenty years ago, but even now she still misses the quiet little village where she grew up.
我奶奶二十年前搬到城市，但即使到現在，她仍然想念她長大的那個安靜小村子。
even a child knows: Even a child knows that we should not throw trash into the river, so why do some adults still do it?
連小孩都知道我們不應該把垃圾丟進河裡，那為什麼有些大人還是這樣做？
even more: After a week of rain, the students were even more excited about the sunny weather and ran to the playground at lunch.
下了一個星期的雨後，學生們對晴朗的天氣更加興奮，午餐時間都跑到操場去。
even + 比較級: We can put even before a comparing word to make it stronger, so after the rain the river was even higher than this morning.
我們可以把 even 放在比較級前面加強語氣，所以下雨後河水比今天早上甚至更高了。
even colder than yesterday: Put on your heavy coat and a hat today because the weather report says it will be even colder than yesterday.
今天要穿上厚外套和戴帽子，因為天氣預報說會比昨天還冷。
even worse: I failed the math test last week, but this week my score was even worse, so I need to ask the teacher for help.
我上星期數學考試不及格，但這星期的分數更糟，所以我需要請老師幫忙。
even + 主詞（連…都）: We can put even before the subject to show surprise, so even my quiet grandfather sang loudly at the party last night.
我們可以把 even 放在主詞前表示驚訝，所以連我安靜的爺爺昨晚在派對上都大聲唱歌了。
Kevin told such a funny joke in class that even the teacher laughed, and she forgot to give us homework that day.
凱文在課堂上講了一個很好笑的笑話，連老師都笑了，那天她忘了出功課給我們。
ever since: Mary and I have been best friends ever since we met on the first day of school three years ago.
自從三年前開學第一天認識以來，瑪莉和我一直是最好的朋友。
for ever: The old man wished that the beautiful summer day could last for ever, so he sat by the sea until the sun went down.
那位老先生希望這美麗的夏日能永遠持續，所以他在海邊坐到太陽下山。
hardly ever: My father hardly ever eats sweets because he worries about his teeth, but on his birthday he always has one piece of cake.
我爸爸幾乎不曾吃甜食，因為他擔心他的牙齒，但他生日時總會吃一片蛋糕。
ever after: The prince and the princess got married in a big castle and lived in joy ever after, just like in every old story.
王子和公主在一座大城堡裡結婚，從此以後過著幸福的生活，就像每個老故事一樣。
the best movie ever: My brother says this is the best movie ever, so he has already watched it four times with different friends.
我哥哥說這是有史以來最好的電影，所以他已經和不同的朋友看了四次。
more than ever: After the long school year, the students were looking forward to summer vacation more than ever and counted the days until July.
漫長的學年結束後，學生們比以前更期待暑假，數著日子直到七月。
as ever: Grandpa is eighty now, but he is as happy as ever and still tells the same old jokes every Sunday at lunch.
爺爺現在八十歲了，但他一如往常地快樂，每個星期天午餐時仍然說著同樣的老笑話。
Have you ever…?: We use Have you ever to ask about any time in the past, so my teacher asked, Have you ever tried Japanese food?
我們用 Have you ever 詢問過去任何時候的經驗，所以老師問：你曾經吃過日本料理嗎？
Have you ever been to Japan?: Have you ever been to Japan in winter, because my family is going there next month and we want some ideas?
你曾經在冬天去過日本嗎？因為我家下個月要去，我們想要一些建議。
There is a strange animal living in the mountains behind our school, but nobody has ever seen it during the day.
我們學校後面的山裡住著一種奇怪的動物，但沒人在白天看過它。
the + 最高級 + ever: To make something sound really special, we put ever after words like best or kindest, so my mother says I am the kindest son ever.
為了讓某事聽起來很特別，我們在 best 或 kindest 這類最高級後面加 ever，所以我媽媽說我是有史以來最善良的兒子。
the tallest building ever: Taipei 101 was once the tallest building ever built, and many people still visit it to see the whole city at night.
臺北101曾是有史以來最高的建築，許多人仍然去那裡在夜晚欣賞整座城市。
everywhere you go: Everywhere you go in Taiwan, you can find a small store that is open all night, so you never worry about buying a drink.
在臺灣你去的每個地方都能找到整夜營業的小商店，所以你從不用擔心買不到飲料。
look everywhere: I looked everywhere for my glasses this morning, under the bed and in my bag, and finally found them on my head.
我今天早上到處找我的眼鏡，床底下和包包裡都找了，最後發現它在我頭上。
everywhere in town: During the festival, there are colorful lights everywhere in town, so the streets look like a beautiful river of stars at night.
節慶期間，鎮上每個地方都有彩色燈光，所以晚上街道看起來像一條美麗的星河。
People everywhere love music, so even if you cannot speak the language, you can still sing and dance together with new friends.
各地的人都愛音樂，所以即使你不會說那種語言，你還是可以和新朋友一起唱歌跳舞。
everywhere（不加 to）: We never put to before everywhere, so my teacher told me to say I want to go everywhere, not go to everywhere.
everywhere 前面從不加 to，所以老師叫我說 go everywhere 而不是 go to everywhere。
here and there: After the strong wind last night, we found leaves and small branches here and there in the garden, but not everywhere.
昨晚的強風過後，我們在花園裡零星地看到一些樹葉和小樹枝，但不是到處都是。
all over the place: When I came home, my little brother's toys were all over the place, everywhere from the sofa to the kitchen floor.
我回家時，弟弟的玩具到處都是，從沙發到廚房地板每個地方都有。
so far: We have read three lessons so far this month, and the teacher says we will finish two more before the test.
這個月到目前為止我們已經讀了三課，老師說考試前我們還會再上兩課。
far from: My new school is far from my house, so I have to leave home at six thirty to catch the bus.
我的新學校離我家很遠，所以我必須六點半出門趕公車。
by far: Jenny is by far the fastest runner in our class, so she always wins the race on sports day without any trouble.
珍妮是我們班跑得遠遠最快的人，所以運動會的賽跑她總是輕鬆獲勝。
how far: Could you tell me how far it is from here to the train station, because my legs are tired and I may need a taxi?
你可以告訴我從這裡到火車站有多遠嗎？因為我的腿很累，可能需要搭計程車。
far from easy: Learning to play the violin is far from easy, so you must practice every day and not give up when it sounds bad.
學拉小提琴一點也不容易，所以你必須每天練習，聲音難聽時也不要放棄。
go too far: It is fine to joke with your friends, but when you laugh at someone's family, you go too far and hurt them.
和朋友開玩笑沒關係，但當你嘲笑別人的家人時，就做得太過火而傷害到他們了。
far too expensive: That shirt looks nice, but it is far too expensive for a student, so let's look for something cheaper in another store.
那件襯衫看起來不錯，但對學生來說太貴了，所以我們去另一家店找便宜一點的吧。
far better: My grades were far better this year because I turned off my phone and studied for one hour every night.
我今年的成績好太多了，因為我每天晚上關掉手機讀書一小時。
not far from here: The hospital is not far from here, so you can walk there in about ten minutes if you go straight along this road.
醫院離這裡不遠，所以如果你沿著這條路直走，大約十分鐟就能走到。
as far as the station: We walked as far as the station with our teacher, and then she said goodbye and we took the bus home by ourselves.
我們和老師一起走到車站，然後她說再見，我們自己搭公車回家。
far + 比較級: We can put far before a comparing word to make it stronger, so this summer is far hotter than last summer.
我們可以把 far 放在比較級前加強語氣，所以今年夏天比去年夏天熱得多。
far more interesting: The book about space is far more interesting than the one about cars, so I finished it in only two days.
那本關於太空的書比關於汽車的那本有趣得多，所以我只用兩天就讀完了。
by far the best: Grandma's beef noodles are by far the best in town, and people wait in a long line outside her shop every weekend.
奶奶的牛肉麵絕對是鎮上最好吃的，每個週末人們都在她店外排很長的隊。
How far is it?: How far is it from your house to the beach, and should we ride there or ask your father to drive us?
從你家到海邊有多遠？我們應該騎車去，還是請你爸爸開車載我們？
fast asleep: When I got home from the long trip, my little brother was already fast asleep on the sofa with the TV still on.
當我從長途旅行回到家時，弟弟已經在沙發上睡得很熟，電視還開著。
hold fast: The wind on the bridge was very strong, so Dad told us to hold fast to his hand and walk slowly.
橋上的風很強，所以爸爸叫我們緊緊抓住他的手慢慢走。
a fast food restaurant: There is a fast food restaurant next to our school, but Mom says we should not eat hamburgers and fries every day.
我們學校旁邊有一家速食店，但媽媽說我們不應該每天吃漢堡和薯條。
run fast: My dog can run fast, so when I throw a ball in the park, he brings it back before I count to five.
我的狗跑得很快，所以當我在公園丟球時，我數到五之前他就把球撿回來了。
too fast to catch: The thief ran too fast to catch, so the police officer called for help on his radio and jumped into his car.
小偷跑得快到追不上，所以警察用無線電請求支援，然後跳上他的車。
fast friends: Lisa and Amy became fast friends on the first day of school, and now they do everything together, even homework.
麗莎和艾美在開學第一天就成了摯友，現在她們什麼事都一起做，連功課也是。
fast（快；形容詞與副詞同形）: Fast does not change its form, so we can talk about a fast car and also say that the car goes very fast.
fast 形容詞與副詞同形，所以我們可以說一輛快車，也可以說車子開得很快。
fastly（錯誤用法）: There is no such word as fastly in English, so do not say he runs fastly, but say he runs fast instead.
英文裡沒有 fastly 這個字，所以不要說 he runs fastly，而要說 he runs fast。
quickly（快速地）: Quickly means almost the same as fast, so when the bell rang, the students quickly put their books into their bags.
quickly 的意思和 fast 幾乎相同，所以當鐘聲響起時，學生們快速地把書放進書包。
quick（快的）: Quick is a describing word, so we can talk about a quick breakfast, but we cannot say he eats quick, we say fast.
quick 是形容詞，所以我們可以說快速的早餐，但不能說 he eats quick，而要說 fast。
drive fast: My uncle likes to drive fast on the empty country roads at night, but my aunt always tells him to slow down.
我叔叔喜歡晚上在空曠的鄉間道路上開得快，但我阿姨總是叫他慢下來。
Our team lost the first three games this year, but we practiced every afternoon, and finally, we won the last one.
我們的隊今年前三場比賽都輸了，但我們每天下午都練習，最後，我們終於贏了最後一場。
finally arrive: After a long train ride and a two-hour walk up the mountain, we finally arrived at the little hotel just before dark.
在長途火車和兩小時的山路步行之後，我們終於在天黑前抵達那間小旅館。
Finally, I want to say…: Finally, I want to say thank you to all my teachers and friends for helping me so much this year.
最後，我想說，謝謝所有老師和朋友這一年來這麼幫助我。
finally understand: After the teacher explained the math problem three times, I finally understand how to solve it.
老師把這道數學題講了三次之後，我終於明白怎麼解了。
finally（最後；終於）: We waited at the bus stop for forty minutes in the rain, and the bus finally came at seven.
我們在雨中的公車站等了四十分鐘，公車最後終於在七點來了。
at last（終於；盼望已久）: After three long years of hard work, my brother at last passed the test, and he finally became a doctor.
經過三年漫長的努力，我哥哥終於通過考試，最後成為了一名醫生。
in the end（最後）: We talked about many places for our trip, but in the end we finally chose to visit Tainan for two days.
我們討論了很多旅行地點，但最後我們終於選擇去台南兩天。
at the end of（在…末尾）: At the end of the movie, the little boy finally found his lost dog, and everyone in the room cried.
在電影的末尾，小男孩終於找到了他走失的狗，房間裡每個人都哭了。
lastly（最後一點）: First, wash the rice; second, add some water; and lastly, push the button and finally wait twenty minutes.
首先洗米；第二，加一些水；最後一點，按下按鈕，最後等二十分鐘。
at first: At first I did not like my new school, but now I have many good friends here.
起初我不喜歡我的新學校，但現在我在這裡有很多好朋友。
first come, first served: The shop only has fifty free cakes for the party, so it is first come, first served.
這家店派對上只有五十個免費蛋糕，所以是先到先得。
safety first: Our teacher always says safety first, so we must look both ways before we cross the busy road.
我們老師總是說安全第一，所以我們過繁忙的馬路前必須看看兩邊。
for the first time: Last summer my grandmother got on a plane for the first time, and she was very excited.
去年夏天我奶奶第一次搭飛機，她非常興奮。
at first sight: When Mary saw the little brown puppy at the pet shop, she loved it at first sight.
當瑪麗在寵物店看到那隻棕色小狗時，她第一眼就愛上了它。
put family first: My father always puts family first, so he comes home early to have dinner with us every night.
我爸爸總是把家庭放第一，所以他每天晚上都早早回家和我們吃晚餐。
head first: Tom fell head first into the pool when he ran too fast, but luckily he was not hurt.
湯姆跑太快，頭先著地掉進了游泳池，但幸好他沒有受傷。
ladies first: When we got to the door, Peter smiled, held it open, and said, ladies first, to his mother.
當我們走到門口時，彼得微笑著把門打開，對他媽媽說：女士優先。
first（首先；第一）: First, you need to turn on the computer, and then you can open the game and start playing.
首先，你需要打開電腦，然後你就可以打開遊戲開始玩了。
at first（起初，後來改變）: At first the water in the pool felt very cold, but after five minutes we all had fun in it.
起初游泳池的水感覺很冷，但五分鐘後我們都在裡面玩得很開心。
firstly（第一點）: There are two reasons I love my town; firstly, the food is great, and second, the people are kind.
我愛我的小鎮有兩個原因；第一點，食物很棒，第二，人們很親切。
the first time（第一次）: The first time I rode a horse, I was so afraid that I held its neck and closed my eyes.
我第一次騎馬時，害怕得抱住馬的脖子閉上眼睛。
first（副詞，不加 at）: When you get to the station, first buy a ticket, and then wait for the train on the second floor.
你到車站時，首先買票，然後在二樓等火車。
look forward to: All the students look forward to the school trip to the beach next week because the weather will be sunny.
所有學生都期待下週去海邊的學校旅行，因為天氣會很晴朗。
move forward: Even though we lost the game, our coach told us to move forward and get ready for the next one.
雖然我們輸了比賽，但教練告訴我們要前進，為下一場做好準備。
step forward: When the teacher asked who broke the window, Jack took a step forward and said it was him.
當老師問是誰打破窗戶時，傑克向前一步，說是他做的。
go forward: If you go forward along this road for ten minutes, you will see the post office on your left.
如果你沿著這條路往前走十分鐘，你會看到郵局在你的左邊。
put the clock forward: Every spring, people in some countries put the clock forward one hour to enjoy more sun in the evening.
每年春天，有些國家的人會把時鐘調快一小時，以享受更多傍晚的陽光。
from this day forward: From this day forward, I will get up early, eat a good breakfast, and never be late for school again.
從今天起，我會早起、吃一頓好早餐，再也不上學遲到。
look forward to + V-ing: My little sister looks forward to going to the zoo on Sunday because she wants to see the pandas.
我妹妹期待星期天去動物園，因為她想看熊貓。
look forward to seeing you: We have not met since last summer, so I really look forward to seeing you at the party on Saturday.
我們從去年夏天起就沒見過面，所以我真的期待星期六在派對上見到你。
look forward to the trip: The whole family looks forward to the trip to Japan, and my mom has already bought a new camera.
全家人都期待這次去日本的旅行，我媽媽已經買了一台新相機。
for free: If you buy two hamburgers at this restaurant today, you can get a large drink for free.
如果你今天在這家餐廳買兩個漢堡，你可以免費得到一杯大飲料。
free of charge: Children under six can enter the museum free of charge, but their parents have to pay one hundred dollars.
六歲以下的兒童可以免費進入博物館，但他們的父母要付一百元。
set free: The kind farmer found a bird in a net, and he set it free so it could fly back to its family.
善良的農夫發現一隻鳥被困在網子裡，他把它釋放，讓它可以飛回家人身邊。
feel free to: If you have any questions about the homework, please feel free to call me or send me an email tonight.
如果你對功課有任何問題，請隨意打電話給我或今晚寄電子郵件給我。
free time: In my free time, I like to ride my bike in the park or read comic books in my bedroom.
在我的空閒時間，我喜歡在公園騎腳踏車，或在房間看漫畫書。
free from worry: When my grandfather sits by the river and fishes all afternoon, he is free from worry and very happy.
當我爺爺坐在河邊釣魚一整個下午時，他無憂無慮，非常快樂。
sugar-free: My mother always buys sugar-free drinks for my little brother because she does not want him to get fat.
我媽媽總是買無糖飲料給我弟弟，因為她不想讓他變胖。
Are you free tonight?: Are you free tonight? My family is going to have a barbecue in the yard, and we want you to come.
今晚有空嗎？我家今晚要在院子裡烤肉，我們想請你來。
a free seat: The train was very full, so the old woman was happy when a young man gave her a free seat.
火車很擠，所以當一位年輕人讓給老太太一個空位時，她很高興。
run free: On Sunday afternoon, our dog loves to run free on the big green field behind the school.
星期天下午，我們的狗喜歡在學校後面的大草地上自由奔跑。
free（免費地；自由地）: Students with a school card can ride the city bus free on weekends, so we often go downtown together.
有學生證的學生週末可以免費搭市公車，所以我們常常一起去市中心。
freely（自由地；隨意地）: In the art class, the teacher let us paint freely, so everyone drew anything they liked on the paper.
在美術課上，老師讓我們自由地畫，所以每個人都在紙上畫任何自己喜歡的東西。
speak freely: Our class meeting is a place where everyone can speak freely, so please tell us your ideas about the trip.
我們的班會是每個人都能暢所欲言的地方，所以請告訴我們你對旅行的想法。
get in free: People who wear a red shirt can get in free at the baseball game tonight, so let's all wear red.
今晚穿紅襯衫的人可以免費入場看棒球賽，所以我們大家都穿紅色吧。
work hard: My mother works hard at the hospital every day, so I try to help her cook dinner at night.
我媽媽每天在醫院努力工作，所以我晚上會試著幫她做晚餐。
study hard: If you study hard for the next two weeks, I am sure you will do well on the English test.
如果你接下來兩週用功讀書，我相信你英文考試會考得很好。
try hard: Although Ben tried hard to catch the ball, it hit the ground and the other team won the game.
雖然班努力嘗試接球，但球落地了，另一隊贏了比賽。
rain hard: It rained hard all night, so this morning there was water on the roads and we could not ride our bicycles.
昨晚整夜下大雨，所以今天早上路上積水，我們不能騎腳踏車。
think hard: The question was very difficult, so Lisa thought hard for ten minutes before she wrote down her answer.
這個問題很難，所以麗莎努力想了十分鐘才寫下答案。
hit hard: The typhoon hit our town hard last night, and many trees fell down on the roads near my house.
颱風昨晚重擊了我們的小鎮，我家附近的路上倒了很多樹。
hard at work: When I walked into the kitchen, my father was hard at work making dumplings for the New Year dinner.
當我走進廚房時，我爸爸正在埋頭工作，為年夜飯包水餃。
a hard time: My family had a hard time last year because my father lost his job and we moved to a smaller house.
去年我們家經歷了一段艱難的時期，因為我爸爸失業了，我們搬到一間比較小的房子。
hard to say: It is hard to say who will win the game tonight because both teams have played very well this year.
很難說今晚誰會贏這場比賽，因為兩隊今年都打得很好。
hard of hearing: My grandfather is hard of hearing, so we have to speak loudly and slowly when we talk to him on the phone.
我爺爺聽力不好，所以我們和他講電話時必須說得又大聲又慢。
hard（努力地；猛烈地）: The wind blew hard all afternoon, and the hard test in the morning also made everyone feel very tired.
風整個下午都猛烈地吹，早上那場困難的考試也讓每個人都覺得很累。
hardly（幾乎不）: The room was so noisy that I could hardly hear the teacher, so I moved to a seat near the front.
教室太吵了，我幾乎聽不到老師說話，所以我移到靠前面的座位。
He works hard at the factory from morning to night, so he can buy a new bicycle for his daughter.
他從早到晚在工廠努力工作，這樣他才能幫女兒買一台新腳踏車。
He hardly works at the shop these days because he is sick, so his wife has to take care of everything.
他這些日子幾乎不在店裡工作，因為他生病了，所以他太太必須照顧一切。
hardly any: There was hardly any milk left in the bottle this morning, so Dad went to the store to buy more.
今天早上瓶子裡幾乎沒有牛奶了，所以爸爸去商店再買了一些。
can hardly wait: My little brother can hardly wait for Christmas because he wants to open the big red box under the tree.
我弟弟等不及聖誕節了，因為他想打開樹下那個紅色的大盒子。
hardly anyone: It was raining so hard on Sunday morning that hardly anyone came to the park to play basketball.
星期天早上雨下得太大了，幾乎沒人來公園打籃球。
hardly believe it: I could hardly believe it when my teacher told me that I got the highest score on the English test.
當老師告訴我我英文考試拿了最高分時，我幾乎難以相信。
hardly know him: I hardly know him because he just moved to our class last week and he is very quiet in school.
我幾乎不認識他，因為他上週才轉到我們班，而且他在學校很安靜。
hardly…when…: We had hardly sat down at the restaurant when the waiter brought us the soup and the bread.
我們在餐廳才剛坐下，服務生就把湯和麵包端來了。
Hardly had he left the house when it began to rain hard, so he ran back to get his umbrella.
他剛離開家就開始下大雨，所以他跑回去拿雨傘。
hardly 本身帶否定: Mary can hardly swim at all, so her father stays near her when they go to the pool on hot days.
瑪麗幾乎完全不會游泳，所以天氣熱時他們去游泳池，她爸爸會待在她旁邊。
I can hardly hear you because the music in the restaurant is too loud, so please speak a little louder.
我幾乎聽不到你說話，因為餐廳裡的音樂太大聲了，請你說大聲一點。
When I asked my mother for money to buy lunch, she smiled and said, here you are, and gave me fifty dollars.
當我向媽媽要錢買午餐時，她微笑著說：給你，然後給了我五十元。
The teacher smiled and said, here we go, and all the students started to run around the big playground.
老師微笑著說：開始了，所有學生就開始繞著大操場跑。
Here comes the bus, so put your phone away, take out your ticket, and get ready to get on quickly.
公車來了，所以把手機收起來、拿出車票，準備快點上車。
here you go: The waiter put two bowls of hot noodles on our table and said, here you go, enjoy your dinner.
服務生把兩碗熱麵放在我們桌上說：你的來了，請享用晚餐。
from here on: From here on, our class will have an English test every Friday, so please study a little every day.
從現在起，我們班每個星期五都會有英文考試，所以請每天讀一點書。
After I looked for my key for ten minutes, my sister picked it up from the sofa and said, here it is.
我找鑰匙找了十分鐘後，我姊姊從沙發上把它拿起來說：在這裡。
around here: Is there a good night market around here? My friends and I want to try some famous food tonight.
這附近有不錯的夜市嗎？我和朋友今晚想吃一些有名的小吃。
come here（不加 to）: Please come here and sit next to me, because I want to show you the photos from my trip to Japan.
請過來這裡坐在我旁邊，因為我想給你看我去日本旅行的照片。
Here comes + 名詞: Here comes the teacher with our test papers, so everyone should sit down and be quiet right now.
老師拿著我們的考卷來了，所以大家現在應該坐好保持安靜。
We waited for Jack outside the movie theater for a long time, and then Lisa pointed and said, here he comes.
我們在電影院外面等傑克等了很久，然後麗莎指著說：他來了。
Here is your book; I found it under my desk after class, and I think you left it there yesterday.
你的書在這；我下課後在我桌子底下找到的，我想是你昨天掉在那裡的。
aim high: My teacher always tells us to aim high, because if we try our best, our dreams can come true.
我的老師總是告訴我們要志向遠大，因為如果我們盡力，夢想就能實現。
fly high: On a windy day, my brother and I went to the park, and our new kite could fly high above the trees.
在一個颳風的日子，我和哥哥去公園，我們的新風箏能高高地飛過樹梢。
jump high: The basketball player can jump high and touch the top of the net, so everyone in the gym cheered for him.
這位籃球選手能跳得很高，碰到籃網的頂端，所以體育館裡每個人都為他歡呼。
high up: The cat was high up in the old tree, and it was afraid to come down until my father came to help.
那隻貓在老樹的高處，直到我爸爸來幫忙，它才敢下來。
high in the sky: We lay on the grass and watched the airplanes fly high in the sky on a sunny Sunday afternoon.
在一個晴朗的星期天下午，我們躺在草地上，看著飛機高高地在空中飛。
hold one's head high: Although our team lost the final game, our coach told us to hold our heads high and be proud of ourselves.
雖然我們隊輸了決賽，但教練告訴我們要抬頭挺胸，為自己感到驕傲。
knee-high: After the typhoon, the water on our street was knee-high, so we could not go to school that morning.
颱風過後，我們街上的水及膝高，所以那天早上我們不能去上學。
prices stay high: Because of the bad weather this summer, vegetable prices stay high, and my mother is buying fewer tomatoes.
因為今年夏天天氣不好，蔬菜價格居高不下，我媽媽買的番茄變少了。
high（高高地；具體）: The young boy climbed high into the old tree to pick some fruit, and his mother told him to be careful.
小男孩高高地爬上老樹去摘水果，他媽媽叮囑他要小心。
highly（非常；高度地）: This new restaurant is highly popular with students because the food is cheap and the service is very fast.
這家新餐廳非常受學生歡迎，因為食物便宜，而且服務非常快。
highly recommended: This book is highly recommended by our English teacher, so almost everyone in our class has read it already.
這本書是我們英文老師強力推薦的，所以我們班幾乎每個人都已經讀過了。
think highly of: All the teachers think highly of Amy because she always helps her friends and never gives up on anything.
所有老師都很看重艾咪，因為她總是幫助朋友，而且對任何事都從不放棄。
highly possible: It is highly possible that the game will be put off tomorrow because a big typhoon is coming to Taiwan.
明天的比賽很有可能會延期，因為有一個大颱風正朝台灣來。
highly dangerous: Swimming in the river after heavy rain is highly dangerous, so the police told everyone to stay away from it.
大雨過後在河裡游泳非常危險，所以警察叫大家遠離河邊。
speak highly of: My parents speak highly of my new math teacher because she explains everything slowly and clearly to the class.
我父母很稱讚我的新數學老師，因為她對全班講解每件事都又慢又清楚。
go home: After basketball practice, Tom and I usually go home together and talk about the games we watched on TV.
籃球練習結束後，湯姆和我通常一起回家，聊我們在電視上看過的比賽。
get home: My father often gets home very late on Fridays because there is a lot of traffic on the road from the city.
我爸爸星期五常常很晚才到家，因為從市區回來的路上車很多。
stay home: When the typhoon comes this weekend, we will stay home, play cards, and watch some movies together.
這個週末颱風來的時候，我們會待在家裡，一起玩牌、看電影。
come home: My sister will come home from Japan next week, and my mother plans to cook a big dinner for her.
我姊姊下週會從日本回家來，我媽媽計畫為她煮一頓豐盛的晚餐。
at home: On rainy days, I like to stay at home, drink hot tea, and read a good book near the window.
下雨天我喜歡待在家裡，喝熱茶，在窗邊讀一本好書。
make yourself at home: Please come in, sit down, and make yourself at home; I will bring you some cookies and a cup of tea.
請進，坐下，別客氣當自己家；我去拿一些餅乾和一杯茶給你。
homesick: During his first month at the new school in Taipei, Peter felt homesick and often called his family in Tainan.
彼得在台北新學校的第一個月感到想家，常常打電話給在台南的家人。
home-made: My grandmother's home-made cookies are the best in the world, and she makes a big box of them every Sunday.
我奶奶自製的餅乾是世界上最好吃的，她每個星期天都做一大盒。
feel at home: Although Lisa moved to a new city only two months ago, she already feels at home with her new neighbors.
雖然麗莎兩個月前才搬到新城市，但她已經和新鄰居相處得很自在。
on the way home: On the way home from school, we often stop at the small store to buy a drink and some snacks.
放學回家路上，我們常常在小商店停下來買飲料和一些點心。
take sth. home: There was too much pizza at the party, so the host asked us to take some home for our families.
派對上的披薩太多了，所以主人請我們帶一些回家給家人。
hometown: My hometown is a small fishing village in the south, and we go back there every Chinese New Year.
我的故鄉是南部的一個小漁村，我們每年農曆新年都會回去那裡。
homework: I have to finish my math homework before dinner because my favorite TV show starts at eight tonight.
我必須在晚餐前寫完數學功課，因為我最喜歡的電視節目今晚八點開始。
go home（不加 to）: It is dark and cold outside now, so let us go home and have some hot soup with Grandma together.
外面現在又黑又冷，所以我們回家，和奶奶一起喝點熱湯吧。
go to school: Every morning my brother and I go to school by bus, but in the afternoon we usually walk home together.
每天早上我和弟弟搭公車去學校，但下午我們通常一起走路回家。
stay at home: My mother has a cold today, so she will stay at home and rest instead of going to the office.
我媽媽今天感冒了，所以她會待在家休息，而不去辦公室。
go to his home: After class, we will go to his home to play video games, and his mother will make dumplings for us.
下課後我們要去他家玩電動，他媽媽會為我們包水餃。
Many people say this movie is too long and boring. However, I like it because the music is wonderful.
很多人說這部電影太長又無聊。然而，我喜歡它，因為音樂很美妙。
however hard you try: However hard you try, you cannot finish all this homework in one hour, so start early tonight.
不管你多努力，你都無法在一小時內寫完這些功課，所以今晚早點開始吧。
however you like: You can cook the eggs however you like, but I want mine with a little salt and no pepper.
你可以隨你喜歡的方式煮蛋，但我的要加一點鹽，不要加胡椒。
however long it takes: However long it takes, I will keep practicing the piano until I can play this song without any mistakes.
不管花多久，我會一直練鋼琴，直到我能毫無錯誤地彈這首歌。
however（然而；逗號隔開）: The test was really difficult for everyone. However, Jenny still got a perfect score and surprised the whole class.
這次考試對每個人來說都很難。然而，珍妮還是拿了滿分，讓全班都很驚訝。
but（但是；不加逗號）: Jenny likes the blue dress but it is too expensive; however, the black one is cheap and looks nice too.
珍妮喜歡那件藍色洋裝但是它太貴了；然而，黑色那件很便宜，看起來也不錯。
however 可放句中: The weather was terrible on Saturday; the picnic, however, was still a lot of fun for the whole family.
星期六天氣很糟；然而，野餐對全家來說仍然非常有趣。
however 不可直接連接兩句: Tom studied hard for the test. However, he still made some small mistakes because he did not sleep well.
湯姆為了考試用功讀書。然而，他還是犯了一些小錯，因為他沒睡好。
inside out: My little brother was in a hurry this morning, so he put his T-shirt on inside out and went to school.
我弟弟今天早上很匆忙，所以他把T恤裡外顛倒穿著就去上學了。
go inside: It started to rain while we were playing basketball, so we had to go inside and finish the game another day.
我們打籃球時開始下雨，所以我們必須進去，改天再打完比賽。
stay inside: The weather report says a typhoon will hit Taiwan tonight, so everyone should stay inside and keep safe.
氣象報告說今晚颱風會侵襲台灣，所以大家應該留在室內，保持安全。
inside and out: Before the New Year, my family made the whole house clean inside and out, and we even washed all the windows.
過年前，我們全家把整個房子裡裡外外都打掃乾淨，連所有窗戶都洗了。
deep inside: Although Mike said he did not care about the game, deep inside he was very sad because his team lost.
雖然麥克說他不在乎這場比賽，但內心深處他很難過，因為他的隊輸了。
look inside: The little girl was afraid to look inside the dark box, so her brother opened it and found a cute kitten.
小女孩不敢往黑暗的盒子裡面看，所以她哥哥打開它，發現了一隻可愛的小貓。
inside the box: My grandmother keeps old photos and letters inside the box under her bed, and she looks at them sometimes.
我奶奶把舊照片和信放在她床下的盒子裡，她有時會拿出來看。
inside out（裡外反穿）: Mary put on her sweater inside out, so we could see the white words on her back all morning.
瑪麗把毛衣裡外反穿了，所以整個早上我們都看得到她背後的白色字。
upside down（上下顛倒）: My little sister held the picture book upside down and looked inside, then she laughed because the people looked wrong.
我妹妹把圖畫書拿得上下顛倒往裡面看，然後她笑了，因為裡面的人看起來怪怪的。
back to front（前後反穿）: Peter wore his cap back to front and his shirt inside out this morning, so his friends laughed at him.
彼得今天早上把帽子前後反戴，襯衫也裡外反穿，所以他的朋友都笑他。
wear a shirt inside out: When I got to school, my friend told me that I was wearing my shirt inside out, so I fixed it quickly.
我到學校時，朋友告訴我我的襯衫穿反了，所以我趕快把它穿好。
Tom did not want to go to the party with his friends on Friday. Instead, he stayed home and read a book.
湯姆星期五不想和朋友去派對。反而，他待在家看了一本書。
instead of: On hot summer days, my mother makes us fruit juice instead of soda because it is much better for our health.
在炎熱的夏天，我媽媽做果汁給我們喝，而不是汽水，因為對健康好很多。
go instead: My father is too busy to pick me up today, so my uncle will go instead and take me to the dentist.
我爸爸今天太忙，沒辦法來接我，所以我叔叔會代替他去，帶我去看牙醫。
instead of going out: Instead of going out to eat at a restaurant, we cooked dinner at home and saved a lot of money.
我們不出去餐廳吃飯，反而在家煮晚餐，省了很多錢。
