外面雨下得很大，所以我寧願待在家看漫畫，也不要去購物中心。
rather cold: It was rather cold in our room at school this morning, so most of the students did not take their jackets off.
今天早上學校的教室裡相當冷，所以大部分學生都穿著夾克沒脫。
rather expensive: The shoes in that store are rather expensive, so let's look at the night market first before we buy.
那家店的鞋子相當貴，所以我們買之前先去夜市看看吧。
or rather: My brother is a good cook, or rather, he is good at making one thing, and that is fried rice.
我哥哥很會做菜，更正確地說，他擅長做一樣東西，那就是炒飯。
rather good: The movie was rather good, but the ending was a little sad, so my sister cried in the theater.
這部電影相當好看，但結局有點悲傷，所以我姊姊在電影院裡哭了。
rather a lot: My mother bought rather a lot of fruit at the market, so we will have apples and oranges for days.
我媽媽在市場買了相當多的水果，所以我們接下來好幾天都有蘋果和橘子吃。
would rather + V: It is too hot to play outside, so I would rather swim in the pool with my cousins this afternoon.
外面太熱沒辦法玩，所以我今天下午寧願和表兄弟姊妹在泳池游泳。
would rather stay home: My father is tired after a long week, so he would rather stay home tonight than go to the restaurant.
我爸爸在漫長的一週後很累，所以他今晚寧願待在家，而不去餐廳。
would rather…than…: On hot summer days, my grandmother would rather drink warm tea than eat ice cream, which surprises everyone.
在炎熱的夏天，我奶奶寧願喝溫茶而不吃冰淇淋，這讓大家很驚訝。
I'd rather walk to school than take the bus, because the bus is always crowded and the walk is short.
我寧願走路上學而不搭公車，因為公車總是很擠，而且走路很近。
rather than + V／N: We decided to cook dinner at home rather than eat out, because the restaurants are full on holidays.
我們決定在家煮晚餐而不是外食，因為假日餐廳都很滿。
tea rather than coffee: My grandfather always drinks tea rather than coffee in the morning, because coffee makes his heart beat too fast.
我爺爺早上總是喝茶而不喝咖啡，因為咖啡會讓他的心跳太快。
Really?: Really? You finished all of your homework before dinner, even the twenty math problems on page fifty?
真的嗎？你在晚餐前就做完了所有功課，連第五十頁的二十道數學題都做完了？
not really: I do not really like hot food, so I asked the waiter to make my noodles without any pepper.
我不太喜歡辣的食物，所以我請服務生做我的麵時不要加任何辣椒。
really good: The new bakery near our school is really good, and its egg cakes are always sold out before noon.
我們學校附近的新麵包店真的很好，它的蛋糕總是在中午前就賣完了。
I really mean it when I say you are my best friend, and I will always be there to help you.
我說你是我最好的朋友，我是認真的，我會永遠在你身邊幫你。
really want: My little brother really wants a puppy for his birthday, so he has been very polite and helpful all month.
我弟弟非常想要一隻小狗當生日禮物，所以他這整個月都非常有禮貌又樂於助人。
Really!: Really! I saw our English teacher singing on TV last night, and she has a beautiful voice.
真的！我昨晚看到我們英文老師在電視上唱歌，她的聲音很美。
Do you like playing the piano? Not really, but my mother wants me to practice for an hour every day.
你喜歡彈鋼琴嗎？不太算，但我媽媽要我每天練習一小時。
really（真的；確實）: It is really cold in Taipei this week, so my mother asked me to wear a scarf and gloves to school.
這星期台北真的很冷，所以媽媽要我戴圍巾和手套去學校。
real（真的；形容詞）: This is a real diamond ring, and it is really expensive, so please be careful when you hold it.
這是一枚真的鑽石戒指，它真的很貴，所以拿著它的時候請小心。
really nice: Our new neighbors are really nice, and they brought us a box of oranges from their farm on the first day.
我們的新鄰居真的很好，他們第一天就帶了一箱他們農場的橘子給我們。
a real friend: A real friend always stays with you when you are sad, and Mary really did that for me last week.
真正的朋友在你難過時總會陪著你，而瑪麗上星期真的這麼對我。
truly（真誠地）: I truly believe my teacher really cares about us, because she stays late to help us every single day.
我真誠地相信我的老師真的很關心我們，因為她每天都留到很晚幫我們。
right here: Put your bag right here next to my desk, and then we can start our homework together.
把你的書包就放在這裡我的桌子旁邊，然後我們就可以一起開始寫作業。
right there: Look, the bus stop is right there across the street, so we do not need to walk far.
看，公車站就在那裡馬路對面，所以我們不需要走很遠。
right after: Right after school ends, my brother and I usually go to the park to play basketball with friends.
學校一結束，我哥哥和我通常就緊接著去公園和朋友打籃球。
right before: My mother always tells me to wash my hands right before dinner because it keeps me healthy.
我媽媽總是叫我就在晚餐之前洗手，因為這能讓我保持健康。
turn right: Walk down this street for five minutes and then turn right, and you will see the post office.
沿著這條街走五分鐘然後右轉，你就會看到郵局。
All right, I will help you with your math homework after I finish washing the dishes tonight.
好的，今晚我洗完碗後就幫你做數學作業。
right in the middle: The teacher put a big cake right in the middle of the table for the class party today.
老師今天把一個大蛋糕放在桌子正中央，給班上開派對。
That's right, the library closes at nine tonight, so we should return the books before dinner.
對，圖書館今晚九點關門，所以我們應該在晚餐前還書。
right on time: The train arrived right on time, so Tom and his family did not miss their trip to Tainan.
火車準時到達，所以湯姆和他的家人沒有錯過去台南的旅行。
right behind you: Do not worry about the big dog, because I am right behind you and it is very friendly.
別擔心那隻大狗，因為我就在你後面，而且它很友善。
serve sb. right: Tom did not study at all and failed the test, and his sister said it served him right.
湯姆完全沒讀書，考試不及格，他姊姊說他是罪有應得。
right, left and center: After the big typhoon, broken trees were lying right, left and center all over our small town.
大颱風過後，斷掉的樹到處倒在我們小鎮的各個角落。
right（右邊；正確；立刻）: Turn right at the corner, give the right answer in class, and come home right away after school.
在轉角右轉、在課堂上說出正確答案，然後放學後立刻回家。
write（寫）: Please write your name on the right side of the paper before you give it to me.
請在把考卷交給我之前，把名字寫在紙的右邊。
the right answer: Only three students got the right answer to the last math question, so the teacher explained it again.
只有三個學生答出最後一題數學題的正確答案，所以老師又解釋了一次。
right-handed: Most of the students in my class are right-handed, but my best friend writes and eats with her left hand.
我大部分的同學都是右撇子的，但我最好的朋友用左手寫字和吃飯。
second to none: My grandmother's beef noodles are second to none, and everyone in our family asks for more at dinner.
我奶奶的牛肉麵首屈一指，家裡每個人晚餐時都會再要一碗。
on second thought: I wanted to buy the blue jacket, but on second thought, the green one looks better on me.
我本來想買藍色夾克，但再想一下，綠色那件穿在我身上比較好看。
second-hand: My father bought a second-hand bike for me, and it still works well after two years.
我爸爸買了一輛二手的腳踏車給我，兩年後它仍然很好用。
every second day: Our teacher gives us a short English test every second day, so we have to study at home.
我們老師每隔一天就給我們一個英文小考，所以我們必須在家讀書。
in a second: Wait by the door and I will be back in a second, because I only need to get my keys.
在門邊等一下，我馬上就回來，因為我只需要拿鑰匙。
wait a second: Wait a second, I think you took my umbrella by mistake because mine is also black.
等一下，我想你拿錯了我的雨傘，因為我的也是黑色的。
a second chance: The coach gave Tom a second chance to join the team after he said sorry for being late.
教練在湯姆為遲到道歉後，給了他第二次機會加入球隊。
come second: Mary ran very fast but came second in the race, and her parents were still very proud of her.
瑪麗跑得很快但在比賽中得第二名，她的父母仍然為她感到很驕傲。
second（第二；秒）: Tom finished the race in second place, and he was only one second slower than the winner.
湯姆以第二名完成比賽，只比冠軍慢了一秒。
two（二）: Two students shared the second prize, so each of them got a small cup and a book.
兩個學生一起得到第二名的獎品，所以他們每人得到一個小杯子和一本書。
the second floor: The music room is on the second floor, so please take the stairs next to the school library.
音樂教室在二樓，所以請走學校圖書館旁邊的樓梯。
just a second: Just a second, please, I need to find my student card before I can borrow this book.
請稍等一秒，我需要先找到我的學生證才能借這本書。
secondly（第二點）: First, we should clean the room, and secondly, we need to put the chairs back in the right places.
首先我們應該打掃教室，第二點，我們需要把椅子放回正確的位置。
seldom late: Our bus driver is seldom late, so we usually get to school ten minutes before class begins.
我們的公車司機很少遲到，所以我們通常在上課前十分鐘到學校。
seldom go out: My grandfather and grandmother seldom go out at night because they like to watch TV and go to bed early.
我的爺爺奶奶很少在晚上外出，因為他們喜歡看電視和早點睡。
seldom seen: Snow is seldom seen in Taipei, so everyone was excited when it snowed on the mountain last winter.
在台北很少見到雪，所以去年冬天山上下雪時大家都很興奮。
seldom, if ever: My father seldom, if ever, eats fast food because he likes to cook healthy dinners at home.
我爸爸幾乎從不吃速食，因為他喜歡在家煮健康的晚餐。
very seldom: We very seldom see our cousins in Japan, so we were happy when they visited us last month.
我們非常少見到在日本的表親，所以上個月他們來拜訪時我們很開心。
seldom 本身帶否定: Mary seldom eats breakfast at home, so she often buys bread at the store near our school.
瑪麗很少在家吃早餐，所以她常在我們學校附近的商店買麵包。
He seldom reads, does he?: Your little brother seldom reads the books you give him, does he, even when they have many pictures?
你弟弟很少讀你給他的書，對吧，就算書裡有很多圖畫？
seldom 附加問句用肯定: Your parents seldom let you stay up late on school nights, do they, even for a good movie?
你的父母很少讓你在上學日晚上熬夜，對吧，即使是為了好看的電影？
Seldom do I eat out with my family on weekdays, because everyone comes home late from work and school.
我很少在平日和家人外食，因為大家下班下課後都很晚回家。
rarely（很少）: Tom rarely gets sick, and he seldom misses school, because he exercises and eats vegetables every day.
湯姆很少生病，也很少缺課，因為他每天運動和吃蔬菜。
hardly ever（幾乎從不）: My grandfather hardly ever uses his phone, and he seldom sends messages to anyone, even his family.
我爺爺幾乎從不用手機，也很少傳訊息給任何人，連家人也不傳。
since then: Mary moved to Tainan three years ago, and since then we have only talked on the phone.
瑪麗三年前搬到台南，從那時起我們就只有用電話聊天。
long since: My grandfather has long since stopped riding his bike, but he still walks in the park every morning.
我爺爺很久以前就不再騎腳踏車了，但他仍然每天早上在公園散步。
since when?: Since when have you liked eating vegetables, because last year you would not even touch a carrot?
你從何時起喜歡吃蔬菜的？因為去年你連紅蘿蔔都不碰。
since childhood: Tom and I have been good friends since childhood, and we still live on the same street.
湯姆和我從小就是好朋友，我們現在還住在同一條街上。
since + 過去時間點: I have not seen my cousin since last summer, so I am excited to visit her this weekend.
自從去年夏天起我就沒見過我的表妹，所以這週末要去拜訪她我很興奮。
for + 時間長度: We have waited for the bus for thirty minutes since the rain started, and it is still not here.
自從開始下雨以來，我們已經等公車等了三十分鐘，但它還沒來。
since 2010: My parents have run this small breakfast shop since 2010, and many students come here every morning.
我父母自2010年起就經營這家小早餐店，很多學生每天早上都來這裡。
for ten years: Mr. Lin has taught English at our school for ten years, and he has loved it since his first day.
林老師在我們學校教英文十年了，他從第一天起就很喜歡這份工作。
have lived here since 2010: We have lived here since 2010, so I know every shop and every park in this area.
我們從2010年住到現在，所以我認識這個社區的每間店和每座公園。
since（既然；因為）: Since it is raining so hard outside, let us stay home and watch a movie together tonight.
既然外面雨下得這麼大，我們今晚就待在家一起看電影吧。
so what?: So what if I lost the game today, because I had fun and I can practice more tomorrow.
我今天輸了比賽那又怎樣，因為我玩得很開心，而且明天可以多練習。
and so on: For the school picnic tomorrow, we need to bring sandwiches, fruit, drinks, paper cups and so on.
明天的學校野餐，我們需要帶三明治、水果、飲料、紙杯等等。
so-so: The movie was just so-so, so my friends and I left the theater a little unhappy.
這部電影馬馬虎虎，所以我和朋友離開電影院時有點失望。
so far so good: I started learning to swim last week, and so far so good, because I can already swim a little.
我上週開始學游泳，目前為止還不錯，因為我已經會游一點了。
When Mary asked if the store was open on Sunday, I said I think so, but we should call first.
當瑪麗問那家店星期天有沒有開，我說我想是的，但我們應該先打電話確認。
My mother asked if I would pass the English test, and I said I hope so, because I studied hard.
我媽媽問我英文考試會不會過，我說希望如此，因為我很用功讀書。
if so: Are you free on Saturday afternoon, and if so, would you like to go to the night market with me?
你星期六下午有空嗎？如果是這樣，想不想和我一起去夜市？
or so: There were twenty or so students waiting outside the computer room before the class began this morning.
今天早上上課前，大約有二十個學生在電腦教室外面等。
so much for: It is raining hard again, so much for our plan to go to the beach this weekend.
又下大雨了，我們這週末去海邊的計畫就沒指望了。
so…that…: The room was so hot that we opened all the windows and turned on two fans at once.
房間熱得如此厲害，以致於我們打開所有窗戶，並同時開了兩台電風扇。
so tired that I fell asleep: I was so tired after the basketball game that I fell asleep on the sofa before dinner.
籃球比賽後我累到在晚餐前就在沙發上睡著了。
so + 形容詞／副詞: The baby was so cute that everyone on the bus smiled and wanted to talk to her.
這個寶寶如此可愛，公車上每個人都笑了並想和她說話。
such + 名詞: Mary is such a good singer and sings so well that the whole class asked her to sing at the party.
瑪麗是如此好的歌手，唱得如此好聽，全班都請她在派對上唱歌。
so that: I set my alarm clock for six so that I would not be late for the school trip.
我把鬧鐘設在六點，以便不會在校外教學時遲到。
Tom said he was hungry after the long hike, and I answered, So am I, let us find some food.
湯姆說長途健行後他很餓，我回答說我也是，我們去找點吃的吧。
So + 助動詞 + 主詞: My sister loves milk tea, and so do I, so we often go to the tea shop after school.
我姊姊愛喝奶茶，我也是，所以我們放學後常去茶飲店。
so…as to: Would you be so kind as to open the window, because the room is too hot this afternoon?
你能如此好心以至於幫我開個窗嗎？因為今天下午教室太熱了。
sometimes late: The school bus is sometimes late on rainy days, so I bring a book to read while I wait.
下雨天校車有時遲到，所以我帶一本書在等車時看。
sometimes rainy: The weather in Taipei is sometimes rainy in spring, so you should keep an umbrella in your bag.
台北春天的天氣有時下雨，所以你應該在包包裡放一把雨傘。
Sometimes I walk to school with my neighbor, but on cold mornings my father drives us there.
有時我和鄰居走路去上學，但在寒冷的早晨我爸爸會開車送我們去。
sometimes yes, sometimes no: When I ask my brother to share his snacks, the answer is sometimes yes, sometimes no, depending on his feelings.
當我請哥哥分我零食時，答案有時是，有時不是，要看他的感覺。
sometimes（有時候；一字）: My uncle sometimes visits us on Sundays and brings fresh fruit from his farm in the mountains.
我叔叔有時候在星期天來看我們，並從他山上的農場帶新鮮水果來。
some time（一段時間；兩字）: It took me some time to understand the math lesson, but I sometimes still need help from Mary.
我花了一段時間才懂數學課的內容，但有時候我還是需要瑪麗的幫忙。
sometime（某個時候）: Let us meet for lunch sometime next week, because I am too busy with homework this week.
我們下週某個時候一起吃午餐吧，因為這週我忙著寫作業。
some times（幾次）: There were some times last year when I wanted to quit the swim team, but my coach helped me.
去年有幾次我想退出游泳隊，但教練幫了我。
It took some time for the new student to make friends, but now she sometimes eats lunch with us.
新同學花了一些時間才交到朋友，但現在她有時候會和我們一起吃午餐。
Come and see me sometime during the summer vacation, and we can ride bicycles along the river together.
暑假期間哪天來看看我，我們可以一起沿著河邊騎腳踏車。
somewhere around: The new bookstore opens somewhere around ten in the morning, so we can go there after breakfast.
新書店大約在早上十點左右開門，所以我們可以吃完早餐再去。
somewhere near here: I dropped my wallet somewhere near here when I was running for the bus this morning.
今天早上我趕公車的時候，把錢包掉在這附近某處了。
get somewhere: After practicing the piano for three months, I finally feel that I am getting somewhere with this song.
練了三個月鋼琴之後，我終於覺得這首曲子有進展了。
somewhere to live: My cousin is looking for somewhere to live near her new school because the trip from home takes two hours.
我表姊正在她新學校附近找住的地方，因為從家裡過去要兩小時。
somewhere between: The post office is somewhere between the bank and the park, but I forget which side of the street.
郵局在銀行和公園之間某處，但我忘了是在街的哪一邊。
somewhere in Taipei: My aunt lives somewhere in Taipei, but I have never visited her house because she moves often.
我阿姨住在台北某處，但我從沒去過她家，因為她常搬家。
Did you go anywhere?: Did you go anywhere during the winter vacation, or did you stay somewhere close to home with your family?
寒假你有去哪嗎？還是只和家人待在家附近某處？
Would you like to go somewhere?: Would you like to go somewhere quiet after school, because the library is too crowded to study today?
放學後想去哪個安靜的地方嗎？因為今天圖書館太擠了沒辦法讀書。
as soon as: Please call me as soon as you get home, because your mother is worried about the heavy rain.
你一到家就請打電話給我，因為你媽媽很擔心這場大雨。
too soon: The summer vacation ended too soon, and none of us felt ready to go back to school.
暑假太快就結束了，我們沒有人覺得準備好回學校。
no sooner…than: No sooner had the teacher walked in than every student stopped talking and opened the book.
老師一走進來，每個學生就停止說話並打開課本。
how soon: How soon can you finish your homework, because the movie starts at seven and we should leave early?
你多快可以寫完作業？因為電影七點開始，我們應該早點出發。
soon after: Soon after we arrived at the beach, dark clouds covered the sky and we had to go home.
我們到海邊不久之後，烏雲遮住天空，我們只好回家。
the sooner the better: You should see a doctor about your cough, and the sooner the better, because you have had it for a week.
你應該去看醫生治咳嗽，越快越好，因為你已經咳了一個星期。
as soon as + 子句: As soon as the rain stops, we will go out and play basketball on the school playground.
雨一停，我們就去學校操場打籃球。
As soon as I got home from the night market, it started to rain very hard outside.
我一從夜市到家，外面就開始下起大雨。
How soon will you arrive?: How soon will you arrive at the train station, because our train to Tainan leaves in twenty minutes?
你多久後會到火車站？因為我們去台南的火車二十分鐘後就開了。
soon（不久後）: The weather is getting colder, so winter will be here soon and we need to buy warm coats.
天氣越來越冷，所以冬天不久後就要來了，我們需要買暖和的外套。
quickly（快速）: Tom finished his lunch quickly, and soon he was out on the playground playing with his friends.
湯姆快速地吃完午餐，不久後他就在操場上和朋友玩了。
still here: It is already eight o'clock, but Mary is still here in the library finishing her science report.
已經八點了，但瑪麗還在這裡圖書館裡寫她的自然報告。
still alive: My great-grandmother is still alive at ninety-five, and she tells us stories about the old days.
我的曾祖母九十五歲還活著，她會跟我們講以前的故事。
still waiting: We ordered our noodles twenty minutes ago, but we are still waiting because the restaurant is very busy.
我們二十分鐘前點了麵，但還在等，因為餐廳非常忙。
better still: We could take the bus to the museum, or better still, we could ride our bicycles along the river.
我們可以搭公車去博物館，或者更好的是，我們可以沿河騎腳踏車去。
still more: The first test was hard, but the second one needed still more time and we were all tired.
第一次考試很難，但第二次需要更多時間，我們都累了。
stand still: The teacher asked us to stand still for the class photo, but the little boy kept moving.
老師請我們拍班級照時站著不動，但那個小男孩一直在動。
sit still: My little sister cannot sit still at the dinner table, so she often drops rice on the floor.
我妹妹在餐桌上沒辦法坐好不動，所以她常把飯掉在地上。
keep still: The doctor told me to keep still while she looked at my sore throat with a small light.
醫生叫我保持不動，她用小燈檢查我痛的喉嚨。
still water: Mosquitoes like to live near still water, so we should throw out the old water in the pots.
蚊子喜歡住在靜止的水邊，所以我們應該把花盆裡的舊水倒掉。
still（仍然；持續）: I am still studying for the test even though it is late, because I want to do well.
雖然很晚了我仍然在為考試讀書，因為我想考好。
yet（尚未；否定句尾）: Tom has not finished his homework yet, so he is still sitting at his desk after dinner.
湯姆還沒寫完作業，所以晚餐後他仍然坐在書桌前。
already（已經）: My brother has already finished his dinner, but I am still eating because I was late today.
我弟弟已經吃完晚餐了，但我還在吃，因為我今天晚回家。
It is almost noon, but my brother is still sleeping because he stayed up late playing games.
快中午了，但我弟弟還在睡，因為他昨晚熬夜打電動。
Grandma made breakfast an hour ago, but my brother hasn't got up yet and is still in bed.
奶奶一小時前做了早餐，但我弟弟還沒起床，仍然躺在床上。
He has already got up and is making breakfast, but his sister is still asleep upstairs.
他已經起床在做早餐了，但他姊姊仍然在樓上睡著。
still 放否定詞前: I still do not understand this math problem, so could you please explain it to me again?
我仍然不懂這道數學題，所以你可以再跟我解釋一次嗎？
go straight: Go straight along this road for two minutes, and the hospital will be on your left side.
沿這條路直走兩分鐘，醫院就在你的左手邊。
straight home: Tom goes straight home after basketball practice every day to take a shower before dinner with his family.
湯姆每天籃球練習後直接回家，在和家人吃晚餐前先洗澡。
straight to the point: Our teacher always gets straight to the point, so her lessons are short, clear and easy to follow.
我們老師總是直接說重點，所以她的課又短、又清楚、又容易跟上。
sit up straight: My mother tells me to sit up straight when I do homework, or my back will hurt later.
我媽媽叫我寫作業時要坐直，否則以後背會痛。
straight away: When the teacher asks a question, Mary answers straight away because she always listens carefully in class.
老師問問題時，瑪麗馬上就回答，因為她上課總是認真聽。
keep a straight face: I could not keep a straight face when my dog walked into the room wearing my sister's hat.
當我的狗戴著我姊姊的帽子走進房間時，我沒辦法板著臉不笑。
straight hair: Mary has long straight hair, and she washes it every evening before she goes to bed.
瑪麗有一頭長直髮，她每天晚上睡前都會洗頭。
think straight: I was so tired after the long test that I could not think straight and gave the wrong bus number.
長時間考試後我累到頭腦不清楚，說錯了公車號碼。
for ten days straight: It rained for ten days straight last month, so we could not play baseball outside at all.
上個月連續下了十天的雨，所以我們完全不能在外面打棒球。
straight（直直地；形容詞與副詞同形）: Please draw a straight line on the paper, and then walk straight to the door without turning.
請在紙上畫一條直線，然後不要轉彎直直地走到門口。
straightly（錯誤用法）: Tom said the man walked straightly down the road, but his teacher told him the right word is straight.
湯姆說那個人「straightly」地走在路上，但老師告訴他正確的字是 straight，沒有 straightly 這個字。
directly（直接地）: Walk straight down this street and you will get directly to the train station in five minutes.
沿著這條街直直地走，五分鐘內你就能直接到火車站。
Go straight for two blocks and turn left at the bank, and you will see the night market.
直走兩個街區，在銀行左轉，你就會看到夜市。
by then: The movie starts at seven, and by then we should have finished our dinner at the noodle shop.
電影七點開始，到那時候我們應該已經在麵店吃完晚餐了。
then and there: When Mary found a hungry puppy outside the school, she decided then and there to give it her lunch.
瑪麗在校外發現一隻餓肚子的小狗時，當場決定把午餐給它。
and then: First we visited the temple, and then we had lunch at a small shop near the night market.
我們先去參觀廟，然後在夜市附近的一家小店吃午餐。
but then: The test was very hard, but then, I did not study much, so I cannot really complain.
考試很難，不過話說回來，我也沒讀多少書，所以我真的不能抱怨。
every now and then: Every now and then my grandfather takes me fishing at the lake, and we talk about his school days.
我爺爺時不時會帶我去湖邊釣魚，我們會聊他的學生時代。
from then on: Tom failed his first English test, and from then on he studied ten new words every single night.
湯姆第一次英文考試不及格，從那時起他每晚都讀十個新單字。
until then: The school fair is next Friday, and until then every class is busy making games and gifts for the big day.
園遊會在下週五，直到那時每個班級都忙著為這個大日子做遊戲和禮物。
If…, then…: If you finish all your homework before dinner, then you can watch TV with us for an hour.
如果你在晚餐前寫完所有作業，那麼你就可以和我們一起看一小時電視。
first…, then…: First, mix the eggs and milk in a bowl, then put them slowly into the hot pan.
先把蛋和牛奶在碗裡攪拌，然後慢慢放進熱鍋裡。
If it rains tomorrow morning, then we stay home and play board games instead of going to the zoo.
如果明天早上下雨，那我們就待在家玩桌遊，不去動物園。
then（那時；然後）: We lived in a small town then, and life was quieter than it is in the city now.
那時我們住在一個小鎮，生活比現在在城市裡安靜。
and then（然後）: I finished my homework, and then I helped my mother cook a big dinner in the kitchen.
我寫完作業，然後幫媽媽在廚房煮一頓豐盛的晚餐。
there and back: The trip to my grandmother's house takes two hours there and back, so we usually leave early in the morning.
去奶奶家來回要兩個小時，所以我們通常早上很早出發。
out there: It is very cold out there tonight, so put on your heavy coat before you walk the dog.
今晚外面非常冷，所以遛狗前先穿上厚外套。
get there: If we take the MRT, we will get there in twenty minutes, but the bus takes almost an hour.
如果我們搭捷運，二十分鐘就能到達那裡，但公車要將近一小時。
There you are, I have been looking for you everywhere since lunch because the teacher wants to see you.
你在這呢，我午餐後就一直到處找你，因為老師想見你。
There you go, this is the last piece of cake, and now everyone at the party has had some.
給你，這是最後一塊蛋糕，現在派對上每個人都吃到了。
There, there, do not cry anymore, because we can buy another ice cream after we wash your hands.
好了好了，別再哭了，我們洗完手後可以再買一個冰淇淋。
up there: Can you see the bird up there on the top of the tall tree next to the school gate?
你看得到學校大門旁那棵高樹上面那裡的那隻鳥嗎？
My best friend was there for me when I was sick in the hospital, and she visited me every day.
我生病住院時，我最好的朋友一直支持我，她每天都來看我。
there（那裡；副詞，不加 to）: My grandfather and grandmother live in Tainan, and we go there every summer vacation to eat the famous local food.
我爺爺奶奶住在台南，我們每年暑假都去那裡吃有名的當地美食。
There is／are（有）: There are three new students in our class this year, and there is also a new English teacher.
今年我們班有三個新學生，而且也有一位新英文老師。
their（他們的）: The two boys left their lunch boxes on the bus, so there was nothing for them to eat at noon.
那兩個男孩把他們的便當忘在公車上，所以中午他們沒東西吃。
they're（他們是）: They're playing basketball over there on the school playground, so let us go and join them now.
他們正在那邊學校操場上打籃球，所以我們現在就去加入他們吧。
There are many people there at the night market every Saturday, so hold my hand and stay close.
每個星期六那裡夜市有很多人，所以牽著我的手別走遠。
The food at that restaurant was cold and the waiter was rude. Therefore, we left without eating dessert.
那家餐廳的食物是冷的，服務生也很沒禮貌。因此，我們沒吃甜點就離開了。
and therefore: Tom forgot to set his alarm and therefore missed the first bus to school this morning, so he was late.
湯姆忘了設鬧鐘，因此錯過了今早去學校的第一班公車，所以他遲到了。
therefore 常放句首: Mary practiced the piano every day for a whole year. Therefore, she played beautifully at the school music show last Friday.
瑪麗整整一年每天練鋼琴。因此，她上週五在學校音樂表演上彈得很美。
It rained all day on Sunday; therefore, we stayed home and watched two old movies with our parents.
星期天下了一整天的雨；因此，我們留在家裡和父母看了兩部老電影。
therefore（因此；副詞）: The bridge was closed for repairs; therefore, drivers had to use the long road around the lake.
橋因為維修而關閉；因此，駕駛必須繞湖走那條遠路。
so（所以；連接詞）: The bridge was closed, so we took a boat across the river and therefore arrived late for dinner.
橋關閉了，所以我們搭船過河，因此晚餐遲到了。
It rained all afternoon, so we stayed in the music room together and played cards instead of PE class.
整個下午都在下雨，所以我們一起留在音樂教室玩牌，而沒有上體育課。
It rained hard all weekend. Therefore, we stayed inside and finished our science projects early.
整個週末都下大雨。因此，我們留在室內，提早完成了自然科的作業。
as a result（結果）: Tom ate too much ice cream at the party; as a result, he had a stomachache and therefore stayed home.
湯姆在派對上吃了太多冰淇淋；結果他肚子痛，因此待在家裡。
go through: Mary is going through a difficult time because her best friend moved to Japan last month.
瑪麗正在經歷一段難過的日子，因為她最好的朋友上個月搬去日本了。
get through: I tried to call my mother three times, but I could not get through because her phone was busy.
我試著打給媽媽三次，但一直打不通，因為她的電話在忙線。
look through: Before the test, I like to look through my notes quickly to make sure I remember the important points.
考試前我喜歡快速瀏覽我的筆記，確定我記得重點。
read through: Please read through the whole story once before you answer the questions on the next page.
請先把整個故事讀完一遍，再回答下一頁的問題。
see through: My mother can always see through my excuses when I say I am too sick to go to school.
當我說我病得太重不能上學時，我媽媽總能看穿我的藉口。
all the way through: The movie was so exciting that we watched it all the way through without going to the bathroom.
這部電影太刺激了，我們從頭到尾看完，連廁所都沒去。
through and through: My grandfather is a farmer through and through, and he still gets up at five to water his vegetables.
我爺爺徹頭徹尾是個農夫，他現在仍然五點起床給蔬菜澆水。
be through with: After he lied to her twice, Mary said she was through with Tom and would not talk to him again.
他騙了她兩次後，瑪麗說她和湯姆結束了，不會再跟他說話。
put sb. through: When I called the hospital, the woman asked me to wait and then put me through to the doctor.
我打電話去醫院時，那位女士請我稍等，然後把電話轉接給醫生。
Monday through Friday: The school library is open from eight to five, Monday through Friday, but it is closed on weekends.
學校圖書館週一到週五八點到五點開放，但週末不開。
break through: Our team hopes to break through this year and win our first game against the school across the river.
我們球隊希望今年能突破，贏得對河對岸那所學校的第一場勝利。
walk through: The teacher walked through the steps of the math problem with us before we tried the others ourselves.
老師在我們自己試其他題目前，先逐步跟我們說明這道數學題的步驟。
through（穿過；從內部）: The river goes through the middle of the city, and many people walk along it in the evening.
這條河穿過城市的中央，很多人在傍晚沿著河邊散步。
across（橫越；從表面）: We walked across the bridge to the other side of the river, and then walked through the small park to the station.
我們橫越橋走到河的另一邊，然後穿過小公園到車站。
over（越過；上方）: The cat jumped over the low wall and then walked through the tall grass to catch a bird.
貓越過矮牆，然後穿過高高的草叢去抓鳥。
walk through the forest: We walked through the forest for an hour and found a small river with very clear water.
我們穿過森林走了一個小時，找到一條水很清澈的小河。
walk across the street: Always look both ways before you walk across the street, and never run through a red light.
過馬路前一定要看兩邊，絕對不要闖紅燈穿過去。
jump over the wall: The boys jumped over the wall to get their ball back instead of walking through the gate.
男孩們跳過牆去拿回他們的球，而沒有從大門穿過去。
today's news: My father reads today's news on his phone every morning while he eats his breakfast before work.
我爸爸每天早上上班前，邊吃早餐邊在手機上看今天的新聞。
from today: From today, I will get up at six every morning and run in the park before school.
從今天起，我每天早上六點起床，上學前去公園跑步。
today of all days: I forgot my umbrella today of all days, when the rain is heavier than it has been all month.
偏偏今天我忘了帶雨傘，而今天的雨比這整個月都大。
a week from today: A week from today we will be sitting on the beach in Japan, so let us start packing now.
一週後的今天我們就會坐在日本的海灘上，所以我們現在就開始打包吧。
young people today: Young people today spend many hours on the phone, so my grandmother worries we do not talk enough.
現在的年輕人花很多時間在手機上，所以我奶奶擔心我們聊天聊得不夠。
Today is my day, because my painting is on the school wall and we are having my favorite dinner tonight.
今天是我的日子，因為我的畫貼在學校牆上，而且今晚要吃我最愛的晚餐。
today（今天；不加 on／in）: We do not have any homework today, so my friends and I are going to the movies after school.
我們今天沒有任何作業，所以放學後我和朋友要去看電影。
this morning: I missed the bus this morning, so today I had to ride my bike to school in the rain.
今天早上我錯過了公車，所以今天我必須在雨中騎腳踏車上學。
tonight（今晚）: We have a big test today, but tonight my family is going out for pizza to celebrate my birthday.
今天我們有大考，但今晚我家要出去吃披薩慶祝我的生日。
nowadays（現今）: Nowadays people shop on the Internet a lot, but today my mother and I walked to the old market near our home.
現今人們常在網路上購物，但今天我媽媽和我走路去我們家附近的老市場。
these days: The weather has been strange these days, and today it was hot in the morning but cold at night.
最近天氣很奇怪，今天早上很熱，晚上卻很冷。
get together: My cousins and I get together at our grandmother's house every Chinese New Year to eat and play games.
每年農曆新年我和表兄弟姊妹都聚在奶奶家吃飯和玩遊戲。
put together: It took my brother and me three hours to put together the new desk from the furniture store.
我和弟弟花了三小時才把從家具店買來的新書桌組合起來。
all together: The teacher asked us to read the poem all together, so the whole class spoke in one loud voice.
老師請我們全部一起朗讀這首詩，所以全班用一個大聲的聲音念出來。
together with: Mary mailed the birthday card together with a box of cookies to her grandmother in Tainan last week.
瑪麗上週把生日卡連同一盒餅乾寄給在台南的奶奶。
go together: This white shirt and blue skirt go together very well, so I will wear them to the party.
這件白襯衫和藍裙子很相配，所以我要穿它們去派對。
come together: Everyone in our class comes together to clean the beach every summer, and we always have fun.
我們班每個夏天都聚集在一起清理海灘，而且我們總是玩得很開心。
work together: When we work together on the school project, we finish faster and learn from each other's ideas.
當我們合作做學校的報告時，我們完成得更快，也從彼此的想法中學習。
stick together: Our teacher told us to stick together at the museum so that nobody would get lost in the big building.
老師叫我們在博物館要團結在一起，這樣才不會有人在大樓裡走失。
bring together: The school sports day brings together students, parents and teachers for a happy day of games and food.
學校運動會使學生、家長和老師團聚在一起，共度一個有遊戲和美食的快樂日子。
live together: My grandfather and grandmother live together with us in a big old house, so dinner time is always noisy and fun.
我的爺爺奶奶和我們同住在一間大老屋裡，所以晚餐時間總是又熱鬧又有趣。
together（一起）: My sister and I always walk to school together because we like to talk about our day on the way.
我和姊姊總是一起走路去上學，因為我們喜歡在路上聊聊一天發生的事。
altogether（總共）: We bought three drinks and two cakes at the night market, and it cost two hundred dollars altogether.
我們在夜市買了三杯飲料和兩塊蛋糕，總共花了兩百元。
get together（聚會）: Every Chinese New Year, all my cousins get together at my grandmother's house and play cards until midnight.
每年農曆新年，我所有的表兄弟姊妹都會在奶奶家聚會，玩牌玩到半夜。
a get-together（聚會）: Our class is going to have a small get-together at a pizza restaurant to celebrate the end of the school year.
我們班正在計畫在披薩餐廳辦一個小小的聚會，慶祝學年結束。
The basketball game starts at seven, so bring your ticket and I will see you tonight at the gym.
籃球比賽七點開始，所以帶著你的票，今晚在體育館見。
tonight's show: Tonight's show is about animals that live in the deep sea, so let's finish our homework early and watch it.
今晚的節目是關於住在深海的動物，所以我們早點寫完作業來看吧。
late tonight: Dad has a lot of work at the office, so he will come home very late tonight and eat dinner alone.
爸爸公司有很多工作，所以他今晚稍晚才會回家，自己一個人吃晚餐。
What's on tonight?: Mom turned on the TV after dinner and asked us, what's on tonight, is there a good movie to watch?
晚餐後媽媽打開電視問我們：今晚有什麼節目？有好看的電影嗎？
not tonight: I want to play computer games with my brother, but Mom says not tonight because we have a test tomorrow.
我想和弟弟玩電腦遊戲，但媽媽說今晚不行，因為我們明天要考試。
tonight（今晚；不加 on）: My uncle is going to take us to the night market tonight, so we do not need to cook dinner at home.
叔叔今晚要帶我們去夜市，所以我們不需要在家煮晚餐。
this evening: Grandma is coming over for tea this evening, and later tonight we will all go to the night market together.
奶奶今天傍晚要過來喝茶，今晚稍晚我們會一起去夜市。
tomorrow night: I can't go to the movies tonight because of my homework, but I am free tomorrow night after dinner.
今晚因為有作業我不能去看電影，但明晚晚餐後我有空。
at night: Tonight the moon is very bright, and my little brother asked me why the stars only come out at night.
今晚月亮很亮，弟弟問我為什麼星星只在夜間出現。
in the evening: My grandfather usually waters his garden in the evening, but tonight it is raining, so he stays inside.
爺爺通常在傍晚澆花園，但今晚下雨，所以他留在屋裡。
too many: There were too many people at the night market last Saturday, so we could not find a place to sit.
上星期六夜市人太多了，所以我們找不到地方坐。
too bad: It's too bad that you were sick on the day of the school trip, because the zoo was really fun.
你校外教學那天生病了真是太可惜了，因為動物園真的很好玩。
me too: When Lisa said she loved the new chicken burger at the school store, Peter smiled and said, me too.
當莉莎說她愛校內商店新的雞肉漢堡時，彼得笑著說：我也是。
too late: We ran to the station as fast as we could, but it was too late and the last train had already left.
我們盡快跑到車站，但太遲了，最後一班火車已經開走了。
all too soon: The summer vacation ended all too soon, and we had to go back to school before we were ready.
暑假太快就結束了，真可惜，我們還沒準備好就得回學校了。
too good to be true: The store said we could get a free phone with every drink, but that sounded too good to be true.
那家店說每杯飲料都送一支免費手機，但那聽起來好到不像真的。
none too: Our math teacher was none too happy when half the class forgot to bring their homework again this morning.
今天早上全班一半的人又忘記帶作業，數學老師一點也不高興。
too little, too late: He started studying the night before the big exam, but it was too little, too late, and he failed.
他在大考前一晚才開始讀書，但太少也太遲了，結果他沒及格。
too…to V: The soup was too hot to eat right away, so we waited for a few minutes and talked about school.
湯太熱而不能馬上喝，所以我們等了幾分鐘，聊聊學校的事。
too young to drive: My brother is only fifteen, so he is too young to drive and has to ride his bike to school.
我哥哥才十五歲，所以他太小不能開車，必須騎腳踏車上學。
too tired to walk: After the long walk up the mountain, the little girl was too tired to walk, so her father carried her.
走了很久的山路之後，小女孩累到走不動，所以爸爸抱著她。
too + 形容詞 + for sb. to V: The water in the river was too cold for the children to swim in, so they played on the sand instead.
河水對小孩來說太冷了不能游泳，所以他們改在沙地上玩。
too hard for me to do: This science homework is too hard for me to do alone, so I am going to ask my sister for help.
這份自然作業對我來說太難做，沒辦法自己完成，所以我要請姊姊幫忙。
too（也；句尾）: Jenny likes to play basketball after school, and her good friend Amy enjoys playing the game very much too.
珍妮喜歡放學後打籃球，而她的好朋友艾咪也很喜歡這項運動。
twice a week: I go to the pool to swim twice a week, on Tuesday and Friday, because I want to be a strong swimmer.
我一週去游泳池兩次，星期二和星期五，因為我想成為厲害的泳者。
twice as big: Our new music room is twice as big as the old one, so there is a lot of room for group work.
我們的新音樂教室是舊教室的兩倍大，所以有很多空間做分組活動。
think twice: You should think twice before you spend all your money on that game, because you may need it later.
你把所有的錢花在那個遊戲上之前應該再三考慮，因為你以後可能會需要這些錢。
twice as much: My brother eats twice as much as I do at dinner, but he is still thinner than me.
弟弟晚餐吃的量是我的兩倍多，但他還是比我瘦。
twice the size: The new mall is twice the size of the old one, and it has a movie theater on the top floor.
新的購物中心是舊的兩倍大小，而且頂樓有電影院。
twice a day: The doctor told me to take this medicine twice a day, once after breakfast and once after dinner.
醫生告訴我這個藥一天吃兩次，早餐後一次，晚餐後一次。
twice（兩次）: I have been to Japan twice with my family, and both times we visited the famous temples in Kyoto.
我和家人去過日本兩次，兩次我們都參觀了京都有名的寺廟。
once（一次）: My mom goes to the big supermarket only once a month, but she visits the small store near us twice a week.
媽媽一個月只去大超市一次，但她一週去我們附近的小店兩次。
three times（三次）: I have watched this cartoon movie three times already, and my little sister has seen it twice.
這部卡通電影我已經看過三次了，妹妹也看過兩次。
twice as…as: Tom runs twice as fast as his younger brother, so he always wins when they race in the park.
湯姆跑得是弟弟的兩倍快，所以他們在公園賽跑時他總是贏。
three times as big: Our school is three times as big as the little school next door, and its playground is twice as wide.
我們學校是隔壁那間小學校的三倍大，操場也是兩倍寬。
under the weather: Kevin felt a little under the weather this morning, so his mother let him stay home and rest in bed.
凱文今天早上身體有點不舒服，所以媽媽讓他待在家裡躺在床上休息。
under control: The fire in the kitchen was soon under control because my father quickly put a wet towel over the pan.
廚房的火很快就控制住了，因為爸爸迅速用濕毛巾蓋住鍋子。
under pressure: Many students feel under pressure before the big exam, so our teacher told us to get enough sleep.
很多學生在大考前感到處於壓力下，所以老師叫我們要睡飽。
under the sea: The movie showed colorful fish and a big old ship deep under the sea, and the children loved it.
電影裡有五彩的魚和一艘躺在海底的大舊船，小朋友都很喜歡。
under one's nose: I looked for my glasses for ten minutes, but they were right under my nose on the kitchen table.
我找眼鏡找了十分鐘，但它們就在眼前，在廚房桌上。
children under 12: Children under 12 can enter the zoo for free on Sunday, so my parents are taking my little cousins there.
十二歲以下兒童星期天可以免費進動物園，所以我爸媽要帶我的小表弟妹去。
under way: The school sports day was already under way when we arrived, and the first race was just finishing.
我們到的時候學校運動會已經在進行中，第一場賽跑正要結束。
go under: The small bookstore near our school went under last year because most people buy their books on the Internet now.
我們學校附近的小書店去年倒閉了，因為現在大多數人都在網路上買書。
under repair: The bridge near my house is under repair this month, so we have to take a longer way to school.
我家附近的橋這個月維修中，所以我們得走比較遠的路去上學。
under the table: The man paid the worker under the table so that nobody would know how much money he really made.
那個男人私下付錢給工人，這樣就沒人知道他真正賺了多少錢。
under（在…下面；接觸或正下方）: The cat likes to sleep under the chair in the living room because it is cool and quiet there.
那隻貓喜歡睡在客廳的椅子正下方，因為那裡又涼又安靜。
below（在…以下；不一定正下方）: From the top of the hill, we could see the whole town below us and a small river under the bridge.
從山丘頂上，我們可以看見整個小鎮在我們下方，還有一條小河在橋的正下方。
under the bed: My little brother put his report card under the bed because he did not want Mom to see his grades.
弟弟把成績單放在床底下，因為他不想讓媽媽看到他的分數。
below zero: The temperature in Hokkaido dropped below zero last winter, so we stayed warm under two big blankets at night.
去年冬天北海道氣溫降到零度以下，所以我們晚上躲在兩條大毯子底下保暖。
above（在…上方）: The birds flew high above the trees, while the ducks swam under the old bridge in the park.
鳥兒在樹的上方高飛，而鴨子則在公園的老橋底下游泳。
over（在…正上方）: A big lamp hangs over the kitchen table, and our dog likes to lie under the table waiting for food.
一盞大燈掛在廚房餐桌的正上方，而我們的狗喜歡躺在桌子底下等食物。
get up: I get up at six every morning so that I can eat a good breakfast before I catch the school bus.
我每天早上六點起床，這樣在搭校車前就能好好吃一頓早餐。
wake up: The loud noise from the street woke me up at five this morning, and I could not fall asleep again.
今天早上五點街上的巨大噪音把我吵醒，我再也睡不著了。
grow up: When I grow up, I want to be a doctor like my aunt and help sick children in small towns.
我長大後想像阿姨一樣當醫生，幫助小鎮上生病的孩子。
give up: The math problem was really hard, but Amy did not give up and finally found the answer by herself.
那道數學題真的很難，但艾咪沒有放棄，最後靠自己找到了答案。
stay up: Don't stay up late playing games tonight, because we have to leave for the train station at six tomorrow.
今晚不要熬夜玩遊戲，因為我們明天六點就得出發去火車站。
hurry up: Hurry up and put on your shoes, or we will miss the bus and be late for school again.
快一點穿上鞋子，不然我們會錯過公車，上學又要遲到了。
look up: If you don't know the meaning of a word, you can look it up in the dictionary on your phone.
如果你不知道一個字的意思，可以用手機裡的字典查閱它。
pick up: Mom will pick me up at the school gate after my basketball practice because it will be dark by then.
籃球練習後媽媽會到學校門口接我，因為那時天已經黑了。
make up: Tom and Jerry had a big fight over a game last week, but they made up and are good friends again.
湯姆和傑瑞上週為了一個遊戲大吵一架，但他們和好了，又成了好朋友。
cheer up: Lisa was sad about her test, so her friends bought her ice cream to cheer her up after school.
莉莎為考試難過，所以朋友們放學後買冰淇淋給她，讓她振作起來。
clean up: After the birthday party, we all helped to clean up the living room and wash the dirty dishes.
生日派對後，我們都幫忙把客廳打掃乾淨並洗髒碗盤。
show up: We waited for Mark at the movie theater for thirty minutes, but he never showed up or called us.
我們在電影院等了馬克三十分鐘，但他一直沒出現，也沒打電話給我們。
turn up: Grandpa can't hear the news very well, so he always asks me to turn up the TV for him.
爺爺聽不太清楚新聞，所以他總是叫我幫他把電視調大聲。
bring up: My grandmother brought up five children by herself, and she still cooks dinner for the whole family every Sunday.
我奶奶一個人養育了五個孩子，她現在每個星期天還是為全家煮晚餐。
catch up: I was sick for a week, so now I have to study hard to catch up with the rest of the class.
我病了一個星期，所以現在得努力讀書才能趕上班上其他同學。
keep up: The teacher talked so fast that many students could not keep up and asked her to say it again.
老師講得太快，很多學生跟不上，請她再說一次。
put up with: I can't put up with the loud music from the next room when I am trying to do my homework.
我寫作業時無法忍受隔壁房間傳來的大聲音樂。
use up: We used up all the eggs making breakfast this morning, so I need to buy some more at the store.
今天早上我們做早餐把雞蛋全部用完了，所以我得去商店再買一些。
end up: We planned to go hiking on Sunday, but it rained all day, so we ended up watching movies at home.
我們原本計畫星期天去爬山，但下了一整天雨，最後我們變成在家看電影。
speak up: Please speak up a little, because the students in the back of the room cannot hear your answer.
請講大聲一點，因為教室後面的學生聽不到你的答案。
sign up: More than forty students signed up for the school basketball team this year, so the coach has to choose carefully.
今年有四十多位學生報名學校籃球隊，所以教練必須仔細挑選。
dress up: On Halloween, my little sister likes to dress up as a cat and go around the streets near us asking for candy.
萬聖節時妹妹喜歡打扮成貓，在我們家附近的街上到處要糖果。
eat up: Eat up your vegetables, and then you can have a piece of chocolate cake for dessert, said Mom.
媽媽說：把你的青菜吃光，然後就可以吃一塊巧克力蛋糕當甜點。
sit up: Sit up straight when you write, or your back will start to hurt after a long day at school.
寫字時要坐直，不然在學校一整天後你的背會開始痛。
be up to: It is up to you whether we have pizza or noodles for dinner, because I like both of them.
晚餐要吃披薩還是麵由你決定，因為兩個我都喜歡。
What's up?: When I saw my friend crying in the hall, I walked over and asked her, what's up, are you all right?
我看到朋友在走廊哭，就走過去問她：怎麼了，妳還好嗎？
up to date: My cousin always keeps his phone up to date, so he always has the newest games to show us.
我表哥總是讓他的手機保持最新，所以他總有最新的遊戲可以給我們看。
time is up: Time is up, please put down your pencils and pass your test papers to the front of the room.
時間到，請放下鉛筆，把考卷傳到教室前面。
turn upside down: The strong wind turned the small boats upside down on the lake, and the fishermen had to swim back.
強風把湖上的小船吹翻了，漁夫們只好游回岸上。
hang upside down: At the zoo, we saw many bats hang upside down from the roof of their dark little house during the day.
在動物園，我們看到許多蝙蝠白天倒掛在它們黑黑的小屋頂上。
hold the map upside down: We got lost in Tainan because my brother held the map upside down the whole time and nobody noticed.
我們在台南迷路了，因為哥哥一直把地圖拿反了，而且沒有人發現。
the picture is upside down: Look, the picture on the wall is upside down, so the man in it looks like he is standing on his head.
看，牆上的圖片倒了，所以圖裡的男人看起來像用頭站著。
turn the room upside down: My brother turned the whole room upside down looking for his keys, and then he found them in his pocket.
哥哥為了找鑰匙把整個房間翻得亂七八糟，然後卻在口袋裡找到了。
inside out（裡外顛倒）: In a hurry, Tom put his sweater on inside out, and he also hung the picture upside down on his wall.
湯姆匆忙中把毛衣裡外穿反了，還把牆上的圖片掛反了。
back to front（前後顛倒）: My little brother put his cap on back to front and held his comic book upside down to make us laugh.
弟弟把帽子前後戴反，還把漫畫書拿反，想讓我們笑。
upside-down cake: Grandma baked a pineapple upside-down cake for my birthday, and the fruit on top looked golden and sweet.
奶奶為我的生日烤了一個鳳梨翻轉蛋糕，上面的水果看起來金黃又甜。
run upstairs: When the phone rang, Mary ran upstairs as fast as she could to answer it in her bedroom.
電話響時，瑪莉盡快跑上樓，到她的臥室接電話。
the people upstairs: The people upstairs play loud music every night, so my father went up to talk to them politely.
樓上的人每天晚上都放很大聲的音樂，所以爸爸上去禮貌地和他們談。
upstairs bedroom: My sister moved into the upstairs bedroom last month because she wanted a quiet place to study for her exams.
姊姊上個月搬進樓上的臥室，因為她想要一個安靜的地方準備考試。
wait upstairs: You can wait upstairs in my room and play with my cat while I finish washing the dishes.
你可以在樓上我的房間等，和我的貓玩，等我洗完碗。
go upstairs（不加 to）: After dinner, I usually go upstairs to do my homework, and my parents stay downstairs to watch TV.
晚餐後我通常上樓寫作業，爸媽則留在樓下看電視。
go up the stairs: There is no other way to get upstairs in our old school, so we go up the stairs to class every morning.
我們的舊學校沒有別的方法上樓，所以每天早上我們走上樓梯去上課。
downstairs（樓下）: I sleep upstairs, but every morning I run downstairs to the kitchen when I smell my mother's cooking.
我睡在樓上，但每天早上一聞到媽媽做菜的香味就跑下樓到廚房。
on the second floor: Our music room is on the second floor, so we go upstairs after lunch every Wednesday for class.
我們的音樂教室在二樓，所以每週三午餐後我們上樓去上課。
usually late: Jack is usually late for school because he likes to stay in bed until the very last minute.
傑克上學通常遲到，因為他喜歡在床上躺到最後一刻。
more than usual: I ate more than usual at the barbecue last night, so I did not want any breakfast this morning.
昨晚烤肉時我吃得比平常多，所以今天早上什麼早餐都不想吃。
I usually walk to school with my neighbor Ben, but when it rains heavily, my father drives us.
我通常和鄰居班一起走路上學，但下大雨時爸爸會開車載我們。
not usually: My parents do not usually let me drink soda, but they said yes at my birthday party last week.
爸媽通常不會讓我喝汽水，但上週在我的生日派對上他們答應了。
usually（通常）: My mother usually cooks dinner at home, and we only eat out on special days like my birthday.
媽媽通常在家煮晚餐，我們只在我生日這類特別的日子外食。
often（常常）: I often play basketball after school, but on rainy days I usually stay in the library and read.
我常常放學後打籃球，但雨天我通常留在圖書館看書。
sometimes（有時）: We sometimes have pizza on Friday night, but we usually eat rice and vegetables at home on weekdays.
我們有時星期五晚上吃披薩，但平日通常在家吃飯和青菜。
seldom（很少）: My grandfather seldom watches TV, but he usually reads the newspaper for an hour after breakfast.
爺爺很少看電視，但他通常早餐後讀一小時報紙。
never（從不）: Judy never eats breakfast on school days, so she usually feels hungry and tired before the second class.
茱蒂上學日從不吃早餐，所以第二節課前她通常覺得又餓又累。
always（總是）: Our English teacher always comes to class on time, but she usually leaves a few minutes late.
我們的英文老師總是準時到教室，但她通常晚幾分鐘離開。
usually 放一般動詞前: My father usually takes the bus to work, but today he drove because he had to carry some boxes.
爸爸通常搭公車上班，但今天他開車，因為他得搬一些箱子。
very well: Jenny speaks Japanese very well because she lived in Tokyo with her family for three years as a child.
珍妮日文說得很好，因為她小時候和家人在東京住了三年。
the very best: My grandmother makes the very best dumplings in our town, and people line up to buy them every morning.
奶奶做的水餃是我們鎮上最好的，大家每天早上都排隊買。
the very first: I still remember the very first day at this school when I did not know anyone in my class.
我還記得在這所學校最先的那一天，那時我在班上誰都不認識。
the very same: Amy and I were surprised when we showed up at school wearing the very same blue sweater on the same day.
艾咪和我在同一天穿著一模一樣的藍色毛衣出現在學校，我們都很驚訝。
at the very end: The movie was long and boring, but at the very end there was a big surprise that made everyone laugh.
這部電影又長又無聊，但就在最後有個大驚喜讓大家都笑了。
not very: The new restaurant near the park is not very good, because the food was cold and the service was slow.
公園附近的新餐廳不太好，因為食物是冷的，服務又慢。
the very idea: The very idea of eating snails for dinner made my little sister cover her mouth and run from the table.
光是晚餐要吃蝸牛這想法就讓妹妹捂住嘴巴從餐桌跑開。
Thank you very much for helping me carry these heavy books to the library on such a hot day.
非常感謝你在這麼熱的天幫我把這些重書搬到圖書館。
very + 原級形容詞: This box is very heavy, so please ask your brother to help you carry it into the house.
這個箱子很重，所以請叫你哥哥幫你搬進屋裡。
very tall: My cousin is very tall for a twelve-year-old, so people often think he is already in high school.
我表哥以十二歲來說很高，所以人們常以為他已經上高中了。
much taller: My brother was shorter than me last year, but now he is much taller and even very strong.
哥哥去年比我矮，但現在他高很多，甚至很強壯。
very 不加比較級: You can say Jack is very tall or much taller than Tom, but you cannot say he is very taller.
你可以說傑克很高，或比湯姆高很多，但不能說他「very taller」，very 不加比較級。
the very + 名詞: This is the very book I have been looking for since last month, so I am going to buy it now.
這正是我從上個月起一直在找的那本書，所以我現在就要買下來。
well done: Well done, class, everyone passed the spelling test, so there will be no homework this weekend.
做得好，同學們，每個人都通過了拼字測驗，所以這週末沒有作業。
get well soon: Everyone in my class made a big card for our sick teacher and wrote get well soon on it in many colors.
我們班每個人為生病的老師做了一張大卡片，用許多顏色寫上早日康復。
well known: Tainan is well known for its delicious street food, so many visitors come to the city every weekend.
台南以美味的街頭小吃著名，所以每個週末都有很多觀光客造訪這座城市。
well off: Peter's family is quite well off, so they travel abroad twice a year and live in a big house.
彼得的家很富有，所以他們一年出國旅行兩次，住在大房子裡。
may as well: It is raining too hard to play outside, so we may as well stay in and finish our science project.
雨下得太大不能去外面玩，所以我們不妨留在屋裡完成自然專題。
Well, …: Well, I am not sure about the answer, but I think the train leaves at nine in the morning.
嗯，我不太確定答案，但我想火車是早上九點開。
do well: Sandy did well on her math test because she studied with her father every night for two weeks.
珊蒂數學考試表現好，因為她每天晚上和爸爸一起讀了兩個星期。
well-behaved: The children were so well-behaved at the restaurant that the waiter gave each of them a free cookie.
孩子們在餐廳非常乖巧，服務生送給他們每人一塊免費的餅乾。
sleep well: I did not sleep well last night because the dog next door barked for hours, so I feel tired now.
昨晚隔壁的狗叫了好幾個小時，我沒睡好，所以現在覺得很累。
well worth: The night market is a little far from our hotel, but the delicious food there is well worth the long walk.
夜市離我們的旅館有點遠，但那裡美味的食物很值得走這一段長路。
feel well: Grandma did not feel well after lunch, so we took her to see the doctor in the afternoon.
奶奶午餐後身體不好，所以下午我們帶她去看醫生。
well paid: My uncle is well paid at his new job in the computer company, so he bought a new car last month.
叔叔在電腦公司的新工作薪水高，所以上個月他買了一輛新車。
well（好地；副詞）: Linda sings very well, so the music teacher asked her to sing alone at the school show next Friday.
琳達唱得很好，所以音樂老師請她下週五在學校表演上獨唱。
good（好的；形容詞）: Mark is a good basketball player, and he also plays the piano well, so everyone at school knows him.
馬克是個好的籃球員，而且鋼琴也彈得好，所以學校每個人都認識他。
speak English well: My cousin speaks English well because she watches American movies every night and talks with her teacher from Canada.
我表姊英文說得好，因為她每晚看美國電影，還和她來自加拿大的老師聊天。
good English: Our new teacher speaks good English, and she also explains grammar so well that everyone understands quickly.
我們的新老師說一口好英文，而且她文法解釋得很好，每個人都很快就懂了。
feel well（身體好）: Ben did not feel well this morning, so he stayed home from school and slept until noon.
班今天早上身體不好，所以他沒去上學，留在家裡睡到中午。
feel good（心情好）: After a long run in the park, I feel good and sleep well at night, so I try to run every day.
在公園跑完長距離後我心情很好，晚上也睡得好，所以我盡量每天跑步。
well（井）: In the old village, people had no water pipes, so they got water from a deep well near the temple.
在那古老的村子裡，人們沒有水管，所以他們從寺廟附近的一口深井取水。
wide awake: It was already midnight, but I was still wide awake because I drank two cups of coffee after dinner.
已經半夜十二點了，但我仍然完全清醒，因為晚餐後我喝了兩杯咖啡。
wide open: Someone left the front door wide open last night, and this morning we found a cat sleeping on the sofa.
昨晚有人讓前門大開著，今天早上我們發現一隻貓睡在沙發上。
far and wide: People came from far and wide to see the beautiful lanterns at the festival in our small town.
人們從四處各地來看我們小鎮節慶上美麗的燈籠。
open your mouth wide: The dentist asked me to open my mouth wide so that he could look at my back teeth carefully.
牙醫叫我把嘴巴張大，這樣他才能仔細看我後面的牙齒。
wide of the mark: My guess about the number of candies in the bottle was wide of the mark, because there were more than two hundred.
我猜瓶子裡糖果的數量差得遠了，因為裡面有兩百多顆。
eyes wide open: The children sat with their eyes wide open as the man pulled a white rabbit out of his black hat.
孩子們坐著眼睛睜大，看著那個人從黑帽子裡拉出一隻白兔。
wide（寬寬地；具體）: The little boy opened his arms wide to hug his father when he came home from his long trip.
爸爸長途旅行回家時，小男孩把雙臂張得寬寬地抱住他。
widely（廣泛地）: This kind of rice is widely grown in the south of Taiwan, and the farms there are green and wide.
這種米在台灣南部被廣泛地種植，那裡的農田又綠又寬廣。
widely used: The phone is widely used by students today, but our school does not let us use it in class.
現在手機被學生廣泛使用，但我們學校不讓我們在課堂上用。
widely known: It is widely known that eating too much sugar is bad for your teeth, but many children still love candy.
吃太多糖對牙齒不好是廣為人知的，但許多孩子還是愛吃糖果。
go wrong: Everything went wrong on the day of our school trip, because the bus broke down and it rained all afternoon.
校外教學那天每件事都出錯了，因為公車故障，而且整個下午都在下雨。
get it wrong: I thought the test was on Friday, but I got it wrong, and it was actually on Thursday morning.
我以為考試在星期五，但我弄錯了，其實是在星期四早上。
What's wrong?: You look very tired and sad today, what's wrong, did you have a fight with your good friend?
你今天看起來很累又難過，怎麼了，你和好朋友吵架了嗎？
wrong number: I called my aunt to say happy birthday, but a strange man answered, so I knew I had the wrong number.
我打電話給阿姨說生日快樂，但一個陌生男人接了電話，所以我知道我打錯電話了。
the wrong way: We walked the wrong way for twenty minutes before we noticed that the museum was behind us.
我們往錯誤的方向走了二十分鐘，才發現博物館在我們後面。
take sth. the wrong way: Please don't take my words the wrong way, I only meant that your new haircut looks different, not bad.
請不要誤解我的話，我只是說你的新髮型看起來不一樣，不是不好看。
in the wrong: After the two boys fought, the teacher found out that both of them were in the wrong and said sorry.
兩個男孩打架後，老師發現他們兩個都是有錯的一方，兩人都道了歉。
Don't get me wrong, I love your cooking, but I am too full to eat another piece of cake.
別誤會我，我很愛你做的菜，但我太飽了，再也吃不下一塊蛋糕了。
wrong side: My grandmother got on the train on the wrong side of the station and ended up in Taichung instead of Taipei.
奶奶在車站錯的一邊上了火車，結果到了台中而不是台北。
Some students like to study alone in the library instead of in groups, and there is nothing wrong with that.
有些學生喜歡在圖書館自己一個人讀書而不是分組讀，那沒什麼不對。
wrong（錯誤地；口語副詞）: You did the math problem wrong because you forgot to carry the one, so please try it again.
你這題數學做錯了，因為你忘了進位，所以請再試一次。
wrongly（錯誤地；正式）: The police wrongly believed the young man took the bike, but a video later showed they were wrong.
警方錯誤地相信那個年輕人偷了腳踏車，但後來一段影片顯示他們錯了。
My sister wrote the word Wednesday on the board, but the teacher said she spelled it wrong and showed her.
姊姊在黑板上寫了 Wednesday 這個字，但老師說她拼錯了，並示範給她看。
Jack was wrongly blamed for breaking the window, but the teacher found out it was the wind that did it.
傑克被錯怪打破窗戶，但老師發現其實是風弄的。
right（正確地）: I was sure that the answer was right, but when the teacher checked it, I saw I had got it wrong.
我確定答案是正確的，但老師檢查時，我才看到我弄錯了。
yesterday morning: Yesterday morning I missed the school bus because I could not find my sports shoes anywhere in the house.
昨天早上我錯過了校車，因為我在家裡到處都找不到我的運動鞋。
the day before yesterday: We had a surprise test the day before yesterday, and I was lucky because I had studied the night before.
前天我們有個突襲考試，我很幸運，因為前一晚我有讀書。
yesterday's news: Nobody talked about the game anymore at lunch today, because it was already yesterday's news to most students.
今天午餐時沒人再談那場比賽了，因為對大多數學生來說那已經是舊聞了。
It seems like yesterday that we first came to this school, but now we are already in our third year.
我們剛來這所學校彷彿是昨天的事，但現在我們已經三年級了。
yesterday（昨天；不加 on）: My family went to the beach yesterday, and we played in the water until the sun went down.
我家昨天去海邊，我們在水裡玩到太陽下山。
last night（昨晚）: It rained hard last night, but yesterday afternoon the weather was sunny and we played soccer in the park.
昨晚下了大雨，但昨天下午天氣晴朗，我們在公園踢足球。
yesterday evening: My aunt came to visit us yesterday evening, and she brought a big box of mangoes from her farm.
阿姨昨天傍晚來拜訪我們，還從她的農場帶來一大箱芒果。
the day before（前一天）: Lily felt sick yesterday because she had played soccer in the rain the day before and came home all wet.
莉莉昨天不舒服，因為前一天她在雨中踢足球，回家全身都濕了。
not yet: Have you finished your science homework, asked Mom, and I said not yet, but I only have two questions left.
媽媽問：你的自然作業寫完了嗎？我說還沒，但我只剩兩題了。
as yet: We have not as yet decided where to go for our family trip, but my sister wants to visit Japan.
我們至今還沒決定家庭旅行要去哪裡，但姊姊想去日本。
yet another: It was yet another rainy day in Taipei, so we could not have our sports class outside again.
這是台北又一個下雨的日子，所以我們又不能在外面上體育課了。
and yet: Tom studied for only one hour, and yet he got the highest score in the class on the math test.
湯姆只讀了一小時，然而他在數學考試中得到全班最高分。
yet again: My little brother lost his water bottle yet again, so Mom wrote his name on the new one in big letters.
弟弟再一次弄丟了他的水壺，所以媽媽在新水壺上用大字寫上他的名字。
the best yet: This is the best yet of all the cakes you have made, so you should sell them at the school fair.
這是你做過的蛋糕中到目前最好的，所以你應該在學校園遊會上賣。
Have you finished yet?: Have you finished your lunch yet, because the bus to the museum is leaving in only five minutes?
你午餐吃完了嗎？因為去博物館的公車再五分鐘就要開了。
Can we open the birthday presents now, asked my sister, but Dad smiled and said not just yet.
妹妹問：我們現在可以打開生日禮物了嗎？但爸爸笑著說還不行。
yet（尚未；否定句、問句句尾）: I have not seen the new movie about the dog yet, so please don't tell me how it ends.
我還沒看那部關於狗的新電影，所以請不要告訴我結局。
yet（然而；連接詞）: The old man is poor, yet he gives food to the street cats near his house every single day.
那位老人很窮，然而他每天都餵他家附近的流浪貓。
My new phone is small yet strong, because I dropped it on the floor twice and it did not break.
我的新手機小卻強壯，因為我把它掉在地上兩次都沒壞。
Everyone says the new comic book is great, but I haven't seen it yet because the library copy is always out.
大家都說那本新漫畫很棒，但我還沒看過，因為圖書館的那本總是被借走。
